# Biographies of Cuī, Máo, Xú, Hé, Xíng, Bào, Sīmǎ

## Cuī Yǎn {.unnumbered #cuiyan}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Cuī Yǎn appellation Jìguī was a Qīnghé Dōngwǔchéng man. As a youth he was plain and inarticulate, enjoyed fencing swords, esteemed martial affairs. Aged twenty-three, the village transferred him to be a Rectifier, he was first emotionally moved and roused, read the Lúnyǔ and Hán Shī. Reaching age twenty-nine, then he joined Gōngsūn Fāng and others in going to Zhèng Xuán to receive study. Their studies were not yet finished, Xú Province Huángjīn banidts attacked and defeated Běihǎi, [Zhèng] Xuán with his disciples arrived at Bùqí mountain to flee the troubles. At the time grain in the county was scarce, [Zhèng] Xuán dismissed and apologized to his various students. [Cuī] Yǎn had already been sent away, but bandits and thieves were everywhere, the roads west were impassable. Thereupon he traveled around the outskirts of Qīng, Xú, Yǎn, Yù, east downstream to Shòuchūn, south looking out the Jiāng and Hú. From when he left home was four years, then he returned home, with zither and books amusing himself.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
崔琰字季珪，清河東武城人也。少樸訥，好擊劍，尚武事。年二十三，鄉移為正，始感激，讀論語、韓詩。至年二十九，乃結公孫方等就鄭玄受學。學未期，徐州黃巾賊攻破北海，玄與門人到不其山避難。時穀糴縣乏，玄罷謝諸生。琰既受遣，而寇盜充斥，西道不通。于是周旋青、徐、兗、豫之郊，東下壽春，南望江、湖。自去家四年乃歸，以琴書自娛。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
General-in-Chief Yuán Shào heard of and recruited him. At the time soldiers were unrstrained and violent, digging and excavating grave mounds, [Cuī] Yǎn remonstrated stating: "In the past Sūn Qīng had a saying: 'If servicemen are not previously trained, armor and weapons are not sharp, even Tāng and Wǔ would be unable to be victorious in battle.' Now the roads have exposed bones, the people do not yet see virtue, it is appropriate to order the prefectures and counties to cover bones and bury rotting flesh, to show compassion for sorrow and grief, and recall the benevolence of King Wén." [Yuán] Shào appointed him a Cavalry Commandant. Later [Yuán] Shào drilled troops at Líyáng, stationed at Yánjīn, [Cuī] Yǎn again remonstrated stating: "Heaven's Son is at Xǔ, the people hope to assist obedience, it is not as good as defending borders and reporting duties, to bring peace to the realm." [Yuán] Shào did not listen, and then was defeated at Guāndù. Reaching to [Yuán] Shào's death, his two sons contested with one another, contested wishing to obtain [Cuī] Yǎn. [Cuī] Yǎn claimed illness and firmly declined, because of this was deemed guilty, secluded in prison, relying on Yīn Kuí and Chén Lín for rescue he was able to avoid punishment.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
大將軍袁紹聞而辟之。時士卒橫暴，掘發丘隴，琰諫曰：「昔孫卿有言：『士不素教，甲兵不利，雖湯武不能以戰勝。』今道路暴骨，民未見德，宜敕郡縣掩骼埋胔，示憯怛之愛，追文王之仁。」紹以為騎都尉。後紹治兵黎陽，次于延津，琰復諫曰：「天子在許，民望助順，不如守境述職，以寧區宇。」紹不聽，遂敗于官渡。及紹卒，二子交爭，爭欲得琰。琰稱疾固辭，由是獲罪，幽于囹圄，賴陰夔、陳琳營救得免。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ defeated the Yuán clan, was designated Jì Province Governor, recruited [Cuī] Yǎn as his Separate Carriage Following Official,^[Separate Carriage Following Official (bié jià cóngshì) was the most senior staff official for a provincial Inspector or Governor. The title of the office derived from the official being honored with having his own separate carriage during Western Hàn when provincial Inspectors actively toured their provinces.] spoke to [Cuī] Yǎn stating: "Yesterday I checked the household registers, it is possible to obtain multitudes of three hundred thousand, indeed this is a large province." [Cuī] Yǎn replied stating: "Now Heaven's Under is divided and collapsed, the Nine Provinces torn apart, the two Yuán brothers personally sought shields and spears, Jì region's masses left as exposed bones in the wilderness. We have not yet heard the Royal Brigades benevolent sound ahead on the road, inquiring after social customs, rescuing from mud and ash, but instead you calculate the armored troops, only taking this as foremost, how is this what our humble province's servicemen and women hope for from Your Enlightened Excellency?" Tàizǔ changed expression and apologized to him. At the time the guest retainers all were subdued and lost color.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖破袁氏，領冀州牧，辟琰為別駕從事，謂琰曰：「昨案戶籍，可得三十萬眾，故為大州也。」琰對曰：「今天下分崩，九州幅裂，二袁兄弟親尋干戈，冀方蒸庶暴骨原野。未聞王師仁聲先路，存問風俗，救其塗炭，而校計甲兵，唯此為先，斯豈鄙州士女所望於明公哉！」太祖改容謝之。于時賓客皆伏失色。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ campaigned against Bìng Province, leaving [Cuī] Yǎn to tutor Emperor Wén at Yè. The Heir Presumptive frequently went out hunting, changing clothes and carriage, his will on charging and chasing. [Cuī] Yǎn's letter remonstrating stated: "Overall I have heard that indulging in roaming the fields is what the Shū warned against, Lǔ Yǐn watched fish and the Chūnqiū ridiculed him, these are the regulatory words of Zhōu and Kǒng, the clear meanings of the two classics. Yīn reflected on the Xià Lord, the Shī praised them as not far off. On Zǐ and Mǎo no music,^[Zǐ and Mǎo are respectively the first and fourth of the Twelve Earthly Branches used in ordinal counting. Here they likely refer to days marked with zǐ or mǎo in the day counting cycle.] ritual believed it scrupulous, these also are the successes and failures of the recent, it cannot be not deeply investigated. The Yuán clan was wealthy and strong, sons of nobility lenient and unrestrained, indulged in roaming and nourished extravagance, righteous sound was not heard, wise men and noble men soon had intention to change expression, bear-like strong warriors degenerated to tools for devouring, assuredly this is how, despite embracing followers of a million and striding and possessing the Hé's north, they had nowhere to place their feet. Now the country is desolate and distressed, kindness and prosperity not yet spread, servicemen and women stand toe to heel, what they long for is virtue. Moreover his Excellency personally drives war horses, above and below labor and toil, the Heir Presumptive should observe the great way, cautious in enacting the upright, thinking of high strategies for managing the state, inside reflect on nearby admonishments, outside raise up far-reaching integrity, deeply ponder being heir and aide, treating your body as a treasure. Yet you rustically wear the lowly clothes of a border guard, recklessly gallop across dangerous terrain, will on the small amusements of pheasants and hares, forgetting the heaviness of the State Altars, this truly is why those with knowledge are sorrowful in heart. May the Heir Presumptive burn screens and discard tunic, to block disappointment by the masses, and not cause Your Old Servant to be deemed guilty by Heaven." The Heir Presumptive's reply stated: "Yesterday accepting your commendable mandate, kindly revealing elegant charges, wishing to have me burn screens and discard tunic, the screens are already destroyed, tunic also removed. Later if there are any comparable to this, may I be again immersed in your instructions."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖征并州，留琰傅文帝於鄴。世子仍出田獵，變易服乘，志在驅逐。琰書諫曰：「蓋聞盤于游田，書之所戒，魯隱觀魚，春秋譏之，此周、孔之格言，二經之明義。殷鑒夏后，詩稱不遠，子卯不樂，禮以為忌，此又近者之得失，不可不深察也。袁族富彊，公子寬放，盤游滋侈，義聲不聞，哲人君子，俄有色斯之志，熊羆壯士，墮於吞噬之用，固所以擁徒百萬，跨有河朔，無所容足也。今邦國殄瘁，惠康未洽，士女企踵，所思者德。況公親御戎馬，上下勞慘，世子宜遵大路，慎以行正，思經國之高略，內鑒近戒，外揚遠節，深惟儲副，以身為寶。而猥襲虞旅之賤服，忽馳騖而陵險，志雉兔之小娛，忘社稷之為重，斯誠有識所以惻心也。唯世子燔翳捐褶，以塞眾望，不令老臣獲罪於天。」世子報曰：「昨奉嘉命，惠示雅數，欲使燔翳捐褶，翳已壞矣，褶亦去焉。後有此比，蒙復誨諸。」
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Tàizǔ became Assistant Chancellor, [Cuī] Yǎn again was East and West Department Assistant and Associate in Recruitment Affairs. Previously at the time of being appointed to the East Department, the instructions said: "You sir have the air of Bó Yí, the directness of Shǐ Yú, greedy men admire your reputation and become pure, brave servicemen esteem your praise and become sharpened, this is ability to lead the times already. Therefore I appoint you to the East Department, go and fulfill its duties." When Wèi state was first established, appointed a Secretariat Writer. At the time an Heir-Apparent was not yet established, the Marquess of Línzī [Cáo] Zhí had talent and favor. Tàizǔ was hesitant, and used a sealed order to secretly consult the exterior. Only [Cuī] Yǎn on open placard answered stating: "Overall I have heard that in the principles of the Chūnqiū, establish the elder son, moreover the Five Office General is benevolent and filial, acute and intelligent, it is appropriate to follow the standard succession. [I, Cuī] Yǎn to the death maintain this." [Cáo] Zhí was [Cuī] Yǎn's elder brother's daughter's husband. Tàizǔ valued his public-mindedness and brightness, sighed deeply, <a href="#annotation-1" id="source-1">[1]</a> promoted to Central Commandant.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖為丞相，琰復為東西曹掾屬徵事。初授東曹時，教曰：「君有伯夷之風，史魚之直，貪夫慕名而清，壯士尚稱而厲，斯可以率時者已。故授東曹，往踐厥職。」魏國初建，拜尚書。時未立太子，臨菑侯植有才而愛。太祖狐疑，以函令密訪於外。唯琰露板答曰：「蓋聞春秋之義，立子以長，加五官將仁孝聰明，宜承正統。琰以死守之。」植，琰之兄女婿也。太祖貴其公亮，喟然歎息，〔一〕遷中尉。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-1" id="annotation-1">[1]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Cáo] Zhí's wife wore embroidery, Tàizǔ ascended the terrace and saw her, believed it violation of regulation commands, sent her home and bestowed death.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　世語曰：植妻衣繡，太祖登臺見之，以違制命，還家賜死。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Cūi] Yǎn in voice and appearance was lofty and fluent, eyebrows and eyes sparse and clear, beard length four chǐ, extremely having majesty and weightiness, the Court servicemen looked to him, and Tàizǔ also respected and feared him. <a href="#annotation-2" id="source-2">[2]</a> [Cuī] Yǎn once recommended Jùlù's Yáng Xùn, although his talents and goodness were insufficient, yet he was pure and steadfast and maintained the way, Tàizǔ at once with ritual recruited him. Later when Tàizǔ became King of Wèi, [Yáng] Xùn, published a memorial praising his achievements and merits, commending and relating his splendid virtues, at the time of people some laughed at [Yáng] Xùn as pandering to the world and superficial and false, saying that [Cuī] Yǎn had been mistaken in his recommendation. [Cuī] Yǎn from [Yáng] Xùn requested a draft of the memorial and read it, his letter to [Yáng] Xùn said: "Examining the memorial, the matter is merely good. In time, in time, there will be changing times." [Cuī] Yǎn's original meaning was to ridicule the commentators that enjoyed censuring and scolding but did not seek circumstance or reason. Someone reported that [Cuī] Yǎn in this letter disparaged the world and was resentful and slanderous, Tàizǔ angrily said: "Prover says 'Merely begat a daughter.' 'Merely' is not a statement of 'good.' 'There will be changing times,' the intention is to be insubordinate." Thereupon punished [Cuī] Yǎn to be a labor slave, sent someone to observe him, his statements and expression were unyielding. Tàizǔ's Order said: "Although [Cuī] Yǎn met with punishment, yet he communicates with guest retainers, his gates like a marketplace, in replying to guest retainers he curls his whiskers and looks directly, as if he has resentment." Therefore bestowed [Cuī] Yǎn death.^[Bestowing death (cì sǐ) was an order to commit suicide. It was phrased as a "bestowal" because being permitted to kill oneself was considered an honor preferable to the humiliation of a public execution.] <a href="#annotation-3" id="source-3">[3]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
琰聲姿高暢，眉目疏朗，鬚長四尺，甚有威重，朝士瞻望，而太祖亦敬憚焉。〔一〕琰嘗薦鉅鹿楊訓，雖才好不足，而清貞守道，太祖即禮辟之。後太祖為魏王，訓發表稱贊功伐，褒述盛德。時人或笑訓希世浮偽，謂琰為失所舉。琰從訓取表草視之，與訓書曰：「省表，事佳耳！時乎時乎，會當有變時。」琰本意譏論者好譴呵而不尋情理也。有白琰此書傲世怨謗者，太祖怒曰：「諺言『生女耳』，『耳』非佳語。『會當有變時』，意指不遜。」於是罰琰為徒隸，使人視之，辭色不撓。太祖令曰：「琰雖見刑，而通賓客，門若市人，對賓客虯鬚直視，若有所瞋。」遂賜琰死。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-2" id="annotation-2">[2]</a> Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Cuī] Yǎn was pure and loyal, lofty and bright, refined in insight, far-reaching in management, pushed forward the fair and direct in the way, stern expression at Court. In the Wèi dynasty's beginning years, he was entrusted with responsibilities of measuring talent, unified and standardized pure discussion, for ten and more years. Civil and military numerous talents, may were identified and selected by him. The Court submitted to his loftiness, Heaven's Under praised him as fair.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　先賢行狀曰：琰清忠高亮，雅識經遠，推方直道，正色於朝。魏氏初載，委授銓衡，總齊清議，十有餘年。文武群才，多所明拔。朝廷歸高，天下稱平。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-3" id="annotation-3">[3]</a> Wèi lüè states: Someone obtained [Cuī] Yǎn's letter, used it to wrap their headscarf covering, walked in the roads of the capital. At the time there was someone who was formerly not at peace with [Cuī] Yǎn, from afar saw [Cuī] Yǎn's name written on the headscarf covering, followed and read it, and therefore reported it. Tàizǔ believed [Cuī] Yǎn had hidden criticism and heartfelt slander, and so arrested and sent him to prison, shaving punishment and sent to labor. The one who had previously reported [Cuī] Yǎn also again reported him saying: "[Cuī] Yǎn as a laborer curled whiskers and looked directly, his heart appearing to not be at peace." At the time Tàizǔ also believed it was so, and therefore wished to kill him. Thus he sent a pure and public-minded great clerk to go manage [Cuī] Yǎn, the orders on the clerk stating: "Report due in three days." [Cuī] Yǎn did not understand. After several days, the clerk therefore reported [Cuī] Yǎn was at peace and calm. His Excellency was furious and said: "Does Cuī Yǎn certainly wish to force me to use blade and saw?" The clerk had these instructions reported to [Cuī] Yǎn, [Cuī] Yǎn apologized to the clerk stating: "I was extremely inappropriate, not realizing that his Excellency's intentions had reached to this." Therefore he killed himself.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏略曰：人得琰書，以裹幘籠，行都道中。時有與琰宿不平者，遙見琰名著幘籠，從而視之，遂白之。太祖以為琰腹誹心謗，乃收付獄，髡刑輸徒。前所白琰者又復白之云：「琰為徒，虯鬚直視，心似不平。」時太祖亦以為然，遂欲殺之。乃使清公大吏往經營琰，敕吏曰：「三日期消息。」琰不悟，後數日，吏故白琰平安。公忿然曰：「崔琰必欲使孤行刀鋸乎！」吏以是教告琰，琰謝吏曰：「我殊不宜，不知公意至此也！」遂自殺。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previpously [Cuī] Yǎn and Sīmǎ Lǎng were friends, Jìn Emperor Xuān [Sīmǎ Yì] was just in his prime, [Cuī] Yǎn spoke to [Sīmǎ] Lǎng stating: "Your younger brother is acute and wise, enlightened and thorough, firm and decisive, outstanding and towering, probably not what you can reach." <a href="#annotation-4" id="source-4">[4]</a> [Sīmǎ] Lǎng believed it was not so, but [Cuī] Yǎn always maintained this opinion. [Cuī] Yǎn's younger cousin [Cuī] Lín in youth was without fame, even of his in-laws and clan many yet thought little of him, but [Cuī] Yǎn always said: "This is what is called 'a large vessel is late to be completed.' In the end he will certainly reach far." When Zhuō prefecture's Sūn Lǐ and Lú Yù first entered the army offices, [Cuī] Yǎn also named them stating: "Sūn is clear and bright, fervent and fierce, resolute and concise, capable of decisevness. Lú is pure and alert, clear in reason, smelted a hundred times without dissolving. Both are talents to be Excellencies." Later [Cuī] Lín, [Sūn] Lǐ, [Lú] Yù all reached the Three Excellencies.^[The term used here for the Three Excellencies is "tripod assistants" (dǐng fǔ).] When [Cuī] Yǎn's friends Gōngsūn Fāng and Sòng Jiē early died, [Cuī] Yǎn supported their orphans, kindness like to his own children. His reflection on insight and sincerity in righteousness  was all like this. <a href="#annotation-5" id="source-5">[5]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
始琰與司馬朗善，晉宣王方壯，琰謂朗曰：「子之弟，聰哲明允，剛斷英跱，殆非子之所及也。」〔一〕朗以為不然，而琰每秉此論。琰從弟林，少無名望，雖姻族猶多輕之，而琰常曰：「此所謂大器晚成者也，終必遠至。」涿郡孫禮、盧毓始入軍府，琰又名之曰：「孫疏亮亢烈，剛簡能斷，盧清警明理，百鍊不消，皆公才也。」後林、禮、毓咸至鼎輔。及琰友人公孫方、宋階早卒，琰撫其遺孤，恩若己子。其鑒識篤義，類皆如此。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-4" id="annotation-4">[4]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: "Towering" is sometimes written "special." I humbly say "outstanding and special" is correct.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　臣松之案：「跱」或作「特」，竊謂「英特」為是也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-5" id="annotation-5">[5]</a> Wèi lüè states: In Emperor Míng's time, Cuī Lín once with Excellency of Works Chén Qún together discussed people of Jì Province and praised [Cuī] Yǎn as foremost. [Chén] Qún believed: "His wisdom could not preserve his person" and disparged him. [Cuī] Lín said: "Great men merely have their chance encounters. As for people like you, are you really worthy of esteem?"
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏略曰：明帝時，崔林嘗與司空陳群共論冀州人士，稱琰為首。群以「智不存身」貶之。林曰：「大丈夫為有邂逅耳，即如卿諸人，良足貴乎！」
:::
:::
:::

### Kǒng Róng, Xǔ Yōu, Lóu Guī {.unnumbered #kongrong #xuyou #lougui}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Tàizǔ by nature was suspicious, had those that he could not tolerate, Lǔ state's Kǒng Róng, <a href="#annotation-6" id="source-6">[6]</a> Nányǎng's Xǔ Yōu, <a href="#annotation-7" id="source-7">[7]</a> Lóu Guī, all for relying on old relationships to be disrespectful met with execution. <a href="#annotation-8" id="source-8">[8]</a> But [Cuī] Yǎn was the most lamented by the world, to the present believing it an injustice. <a href="#annotation-9" id="source-9">[9]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，太祖性忌，有所不堪者，魯國孔融、〔一〕南陽許攸、〔二〕婁圭，皆以恃舊不虔見誅。〔三〕而琰最為世所痛惜，至今冤之。〔四〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-6" id="annotation-6">[6]</a> [Kǒng] Róng appellation Wénjǔ.

Xù Hàn shū states: [Kǒng] Róng was Kǒng-zǐ's twentieth generation descendant. His great-great-grandfather [Kǒng] Shàng was a Jùlù Administrator. His father [Kǒng] Zhòu was a Tàishān Commandant. [Kǒng] Róng as a child had extraordinary talent. At the time Hénán Intendant Lǐ Yīng had heavy fame, ordered his gatemen to selectively let through guest retainers, if they were not the present era's outstanding and worthy or the descendants of a friendly family he would not see them. [Kǒng] Róng was aged over ten years, wished to observe his conduct as a man, and therefore went to [Lǐ] Yīng's gate, and spoke to the gate keepers stating: "I am a descendant of a friendly family of Lord Lǐ." [Lǐ] Yīng met [Kǒng] Róng and asked him stating: "Your lofty and enlightened father or grandfather once associated with me?"^[Lǐ Yīng uses Pú as his first person pronoun.] [Kǒng] Róng said: "Indeed. My ancestor Kong-zǐ with your lordship's ancestor Lǐ Lǎo-jūn were the same in virtue and comparable in righteousness and so treated one another as teacher and friend,^[This is a reference to the Spring and Autumn era thinkers and statements Kǒng-zǐ and Lǎo-zǐ, who respectively became the forefathers of the Classicist (or "Confucian") and Daoist (or Taoist) schools of though, and had reportedly met one another.] so [I, Kǒng] Róng with you sir are friendly families for accumulated generations." The mass of the seated marveled at him, all saying: "An extraordinary boy." Grand Central Grandee Chén Wěi later arrived, those seated together told [Chén] Wěi of this, [Chén] Wěi said: "People who are clever when small, when grown also are not necessarily marvelous." [Kǒng] Róng answered stating: "Just as as you say, when your lordship was a child, were you truly intelligent?" [Lǐ] Yīng greatly laughed, looked back and spoke stating: "Lofty and enlightened, when you grow up, you certainly will become a great vessel." Shānyáng's Zhāng Jiǎn for his uprightness incurred the anger and hatred of Central Regular Attendant Hóu Lǎn, [Hóu] Lǎn had an edited charter^[Edited charter (kān zhāng) refers to an official document that has been modified.] sent down to the prefectures to arrest [Zhāng] Jiǎn. [Zhāng] Jiǎn and [Kǒng] Róng's elder brother Bāo^[Bāo can also be read Fú or Fóu.] had an old friendship, and fled to take refuge with [Kǒng] Bāo. I thappened that [Kǒng] Bāo had gone out, at the time [Kǒng] Róng was aged sixteen, [Zhāng] Jiǎn due to his youth did not inform him. [Kǒng] Róng understood [Zhāng] Jiǎn was elder, had a distressed expression, and spoke stating: "Am I alone unable to be a host for your lordship?" Therefore he kept and sheltered and hid him. Later the matter leaked, the state's Chancellor on down secretly arrived to arrest, [Zhāng] Jiǎn was able to escape and flee, immediately arrested [Kǒng] Róng and [Kǒng] Bāo and sent to prison. [Kǒng] Róng said: "The one who protected and accepted and hid and sheltered was [me, Kǒng] Róng, [I, Kǒng] Róng should be implicated in it." [Kǒng] Bāo said: "He came to seek me, the crime is due to me, not my younger brother's fault I should be implicated to it." Elder brother and younger brother competed to die, the prefecture and county were doubtful and unable to decide, and so sent up the appeals, Edict letter had [Kǒng] Bāo implicated. [Kǒng] Róng because of this had fame shake far and near, with Píngyuán's Táoqiū Hóng, Chénliú's Biān Ràng, all were considered outstanding and refined, the top of the upcoming generation. [Kǒng] Róng in debate and management did not reach [Biān] Ràng and the rest, but his outstanding talent and vast broadness surpassed them. The Excellency over the Masses and General-in-Chief recruited and nominated him as High Degree,^[High Degree (gāodì) was a type of nomination for government office candidacy.] accumulated promotion to North Army Central Captain, Tiger Elite Central Cadet General, Chancellor of Běihǎi, at the time aged thirty-eight. Continuing after the destruction and ruin of the Huángjīn, he repaired and restored cities and towns, esteemed education, established school halls, nominated worthy talents, honored classicist scholars. He nominated Péng Qiú as Fair-Upright, Bǐng Yuán as Having the Way, Wáng Xiū as Filial-Incorruptible.^[Fair-Upright (fāngzhèng), Having the Way (yǒudào), and Filial-Incorruptible (xiàolián) are all types of nomination for government office candicacy.] He informed Gāomì county to for Zhèng Xuán specially establish one village, named as Zhènggōng village.[Gāomì county was in Běihǎi prefecture. It was also the home county of Zhèng Xuán.] Also if his country men were without posterity, and from the Four Quarters traveling servicemen had any that died, for all he made wooden coffins and encoffined and buried them. A prefecture man Zhēn Zǐrán for filial conduct was famed, early died, [Kǒng] Róng regretted not meeting him in time, and so ordered he receive accompaniment sacrifices at the county Altar. His courtesy to the worthy was like this. In the prefecture for six years, Liú Bèi memorialized [Kǒng] Róng as designate Qīng Province Inspector. Jiàn'ān Inaugural Year [196], he was summoned to return to be General Architect, promoted to Minister Treasurer. Every time the Court gathered for consultations, at once he was the manager of the discussions, the various ministers lent their names and nothing more.

Sīmǎ Biāo's Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Kǒng] Róng at Běihǎi, believed himself exceptionally equipped with intelligence and capability, overflowing with talent and fated for the age, the heroic and eminent of the present time all incapable of reaching him. Also he allowed himself to have great ambitions, moreover wished to raise an army with shining armor, with various worthies take credit for achievements, personally in Hǎi-Dài bind and grow root foundations, not agreeing to be commonly busy like an ordinary residing prefecture administrator, serving the regional governors and attending scheduled meetings and nothing more. However in his appointments and emplooyments he enjoyed the strange and sought the unusual, all were frivolous and superficial talents. As for servicemen that studied antiquity, he feigned deference and respect, although the rituals were prepared, he did not discuss state affairs with them. Gāomì's Zhèng Xuán he called as Zhèng-gōng, using the rituals of a descendant. Reaching to high conversations and instruction orders, they filled and overflowed the office departments, the statements and airs warm and refined, could be amusing to recite. In discussing affairs and investigating facts, they were difficult to be actually implemented. He was only capable of spreading wide a net, his personal management was extremely negligent. When a tax collection was slightly delayed, in one morning he killed five divisions of Postal Supervisors.^[Postal Supervisors (dūyóu) were prefectural staff officials in charge of supervising other officials, spreading and delivering government orders, and touring and inspecting the counties, prisons, and postal relay stations. They were organized into divisions (bù). It might be possible that "five divisions" here could potentially mean "all divisions."] Treacherous civilians and corrupt clerks craftily disordered Court and markets, also he could not govern them. Yōu Province elite troops made chaos, reached Xú Province, suddenly arrived below the city walls, the entire state was all afraid. [Kǒng] Róng directly went out to persuade them, to have them be without disloyal ambitions. Then he with separate officers plotted a night raid on the Yōu Province [Army], the Yōu Province Army was defeated, he took over all their multitudes. In no time, they returned to again rebel and desert. When the Huángjīn were about to arrive, [Kǒng] Róng greatly drank pure alcohol, personally mounted horse, resisting them above the Lái river. The enemy had their upper division with [Kǒng] Róng resist one another, two wings directly wade the river, directly arriving at the headquarters city. The city fell, [Kǒng] Róng was not able to enter, turned and reached the southern counties, the Left and Right gradually abandoned him. For successive years of overturn and collapse, of affairs none were relieved, therefore he could not protect and guard the four borders, abandoned the prefecture and left. Later he moved to Xú Province, as Bĕihǎi Chancellor personally returned as designate Qīng Province Inspector, headquarters at the prefecture's north frontier. He wished to attach the east of the mountains, outside connect with Liáodōng, obtain the advantage of war horses, establish and plant a root foundation, stand alone in one corner, and not join with others. At the time Cáo, Yuán, and Gōngsūn were head to tail with one another, his battle soldiers did not fill several hundred, his grain did not reach ten thousand hú. Wáng Zǐfǎ and Liú Kǒngcí were vicious debaters of petty talent, he trusted them as belly and heart. Zuǒ Chéngzǔ and Liú Yìxún were pure and eminent servicemen, prepared with sitting mats and nothing more, saying these were looked toward by the people and could not be lost. [Zuǒ] Chéngzǔ urged [Kǒng] Róng to enstrust himself to a strong state, [Kǒng] Róng did not listen and killed him. [Liú] Yìxùn abandoned him and left. Then he was attacked by Yuán Tán, from spring to summer, the city small and enemy many, flying arrows gathering like rain, however [Kǒng] Róng laned on table and calmly sat, reading books and discussing opinions at ease. The city fell and the multitudes fled, he personally fled east of the mountains, his household and family were taken prisoner by [Yuán] Tán.

Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì states: [Kǒng] Róng was in the prefecture for eight years, and barely himself escaped. The Emperor had newly set capital at Xǔ, [Kǒng] Róng believed it appropriate to overall comply with old regulations, settle the Royal Domain, correct the Sīlì division into the Thousand Lǐ domain,^[This is a reference to the Nine Domains (jiǔ fú) system of geographical administration defined in the classic Zhōu Lǐ, an ancient Zhōu era ideal of organizing the realm into nine concentric areas around the capital. At the center was the Royal Domain (wáng jī), a thousand lǐ square around the capital city. During Hàn, the realm was instead organized into provinces, the Sīlì division was the provincial level unit that contained the Hàn era capitals Cháng'ān and Luòyáng.] and so had the Excellencies and Ministers send up letters to explain this principle. At the time Heaven's Under was newly restablished, the powers of Cáo and Yuán not yet organized, what [Kǒng] Róng established and made clear had no understanding of the circumstances of the times. Also by nature he was spirited and frank, tended to follow his life long habits, was overly familiar and disrespectful to Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ established an alcohol prohibition,^[Alcohol prohibitions may have been intended to encourage grain and food conversation in times of scarcity and famine. Grain used to make alcohol was grain not being used to feed people.] and [Kǒng] Róng's letter mocked it stating: "Heaven has the stars of Jiǔqí ("Alcohol Flag"),^[The Jiǔqí asterism is three stars, corresponding to Psi Leo, Xi Leo, and Omega Leo.] Earth has the prefecture of Jiǔquán ("Alcohol Spring"), Humanity has the virtue of excellent alcohol, therefore if Yáo did not drink a thousand goblets, he would not have completed his sagacity. Moreover Jié and Zhòu by sensuality lost their states, now the Order does not prohibit marriage." Although Tàizǔ outside was tolerant, but inside he could not be at ease. Censorate Grandee Chī Lǜ knew of his intentions,^[Chī can also be read as Xī.] and used the law to remove [Kǒng] Róng from office. After over a year, he was appointed Grand Central Grandee. Although he resided at home and lost his (political) power, yet guest retainers daily filled his gates, he loved talents and delighted in alcohol, always sighed stating: "With the seat tops full of guests, the goblet center not empty of alcohol, I have no worries." The Tiger Elite Guard had someone who looked like Cài Yōng, every time [Kǒng] Róng was intoxicated from alcohol, at once he would invite him to sit together, stating: "Though lacking the elder accomplished men, yet there are the canons and laws."^[This is a quote from the song Dàng in the Shījīng.] His fondness of servicemen was like this.

Xù Hàn shū states: Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo with Yuán Shù had a marriage connection, when [Yuán] Shù usurped title, Tàizǔ with [Yáng] Biāo had conflict and he took advantage to arrest [Yáng] Biāo, about to kill him. [Kǒng] Róng heard of this, did not wait to put on Court dress, went to meet Tàizǔ and said: "Yáng-gōng for accumulated generations has pure virtue, for four reigns weighty and glorious, By the Zhōu shū: 'For father and son, elder brother and younger brother, punishments do not extend to one another.' All the more for the punishment of the Yuán clan. The Yì stating: 'Accumulated goodness brings surplus celebrations' is only to deceive people then.' Tàizǔ said: "It is the intention of the country." [Kǒng] Róng said: "Supposing if King Chéng had wished to kill the Shào-gōng, then could Zhōu-gōng be able to say he was unaware? Now the reason that the tassel capped and sash sticking servicemen^[Sash sticking (jìn shēn) refer to the ancient practice of government officials carrying their ceremonial tablets by sticking them through their belt sashes.] of Heaven's Under look up to Your Enlightened Excellency, is only because of Your Enlightened Excellency's acute intelligence and benevolent wisdom, assisting and supporting the Hàn Court, promoting the straight and punishing the crooked, leading to harmony and prosperity. Now to without reason kill one without crime, then Within the Seas will watch and listen, and who will not break apart? I Kǒng Róng am a man of Lǔ state, tomorrow I will lift my robe and leave, and not again attend Court." Tàizǔ's thoughts were resolved, therefore he arranged to release [Yáng] Biāo.

Wèi-shì Chūnqiū states: At the defeat of Yuán Shào, [Kǒng] Róng's letter to Tàizǔ said: "King Wǔ attacked Zhòu and had Dájǐ bestowed on Zhōu-gōng." Tàizǔ because [Kǒng] Róng was widely learned believed it recorded in historical texts. Later they met, asked about it, replied stating: "Using the present to judge it, I merely think it must have been so."^[Dájǐ was a concubine of King Zhòu, last King of Shāng. Legends grew that she was a beauty that bewitched the King, blaming her for the decline and fall of Shāng. Here Kǒng Róng is implicitly criticizing Cáo Cāo for improperly benefiting from the defeat of Yuán Shào, possibly a criticism of Cáo Cāo's son Cáo Pī taking as concubine the lady Zhēn, a concubine of the then still living Yuán Xī, son of Yuán Shào.] Thirteenth Year [208], [Kǒng] Róng in answering Sūn Quán's envoy had words of ridicule and slander, in connection he was executed in the market. His two children were aged eight years, at the time were just playing Yìqí,^[Yìqí is an ancient board game, commonly known as Go from the Japanese pronunciation Igo.] [Kǒng] Róng had been arrested, they sat upright and did not get up. The Left and Right said: "Your father meets with arrest, why do you not get up?" The two children said: "How are the eggs not broken when the nest is destroyed?" Therefore they were all killed. [Kǒng] Róng had high fame and pure talent, in the world many mourned him. Tàizǔ feared the criticisms of far and near, and so his Order said: "Grand Central Grandee Kǒng Róng has been sumbitted to punishment, however of the people of the world many value his empty reputation, few verify the facts, see that [Kǒng] Róng was superficial and glamorous, enjoyed making contrarian changes, dazzled by his deceit, no longer examining his disordering of customs. His province's man reported that Píngyuán's Mí Héng^[Mí can also be read as Nǐ.] received and transmitted [Kǒng] Róng's discourse, believing: 'Fathers and mothers with people are without kinship, for example like a clay vessel holding things inside it.' He also said: 'If encountering a famine, if one's father is not worthy, it is better to provide for and save the life of other people.'^[These inflammatory and radical attacks on the concept of filial piety were very serious during Hàn. Note that filial piety was considered so important during Hàn that every Hàn Emperor postumous name except for the two founders Gāo and Guāng-Wǔ formally contain the name Xiào "Filial."] [Kǒng] Róng violates nature and opposes the way, destructive in discourse and chaotic in reasoning, although he was executed in the market, yet I regret it as too late. Further have this affair arranged above, announced and shown to the various army commanders and assistants and associates, all are to hear and see."

Shìyǔ states: [Kǒng] Róng's two children both were losing milk teeth. [Kǒng] Róng met with arrest, looked back and said to his two children: "Why do you not say farewell?" The two children both said: "With our father like this, what farewell is there?" believing they would certainly die together.

Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Shìyǔ saying that [Kǒng] Róng's two childre not saying farewell, knowing they would certainly die together, yet could be possible. As for the words of Sūn Shèng, it truly is not understandable. Small boys of eight years able to have profound understanding of disaster and fortune, intelligent and especially understanding, outstanding already by far, then their feelings of sorrow and joy also should exceed those of an adult, how could they see their father arrested and yet be without change in expression, playing yìqí without getting up, as if at leisure and ease? In the past when Shēn Shēng faced his fate, his speech did not forget his father, he did not because his own self was about to die yet abandon the feelings of concern for his father. If it could be like this for a safe father, then all the more for in hardship and fall? [Sūn] Shèng believing this to be a beautiful anecdote, is it not then damaging the feelings of being the child of someone? Probably it was because he enjoyed the strange and very sentimental, but did not understand the story damages reason.

::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　融字文舉。續漢書曰：融，孔子二十世孫也。高祖父尚，鉅鹿太守。父宙，太山都尉。融幼有異才。時河南尹李膺有重名，敕門下簡通賓客，非當世英賢及通家子孫弗見也。融年十餘歲，欲觀其為人，遂造膺門，語門者曰：「我，李君通家子孫也。」膺見融，問曰：「高明父祖，嘗與僕周旋乎？」融曰：「然。先君孔子與君先人李老君，同德比義而相師友，則融與君累世通家也。」眾坐奇之，僉曰：「異童子也。」太中大夫陳煒後至，同坐以告煒，煒曰：「人小時了了者，大亦未必奇也。」融答曰：「即如所言，君之幼時，豈實慧乎！」膺大笑，顧謂曰：「高明長大，必為偉器。」山陽張儉，以中正為中常侍侯覽所忿疾，覽為刊章下州郡捕儉。儉與融兄裦有舊，亡投裦。遇裦出，時融年十六，儉以其少不告也。融知儉長者，有窘迫色，謂曰：「吾獨不能為君主邪！」因留舍藏之。後事泄，國相以下密就掩捕，儉得脫走，登時收融及裦送獄。融曰：「保納藏舍者融也，融當坐之。」裦曰：「彼來求我，罪我之由，非弟之過，我當坐之。」兄弟爭死，郡縣疑不能決，乃上讞，詔書令裦坐焉。融由是名震遠近，與平原陶丘洪、陳留邊讓，並以俊秀，為後進冠蓋。融持論經理不及讓等，而逸才宏博過之。司徒大將軍辟舉高第，累遷北軍中候、虎賁中郎將、北海相，時年三十八。承黃巾殘破之後，修復城邑，崇學校，設庠序，舉賢才，顯儒士。以彭璆為方正，邴原為有道，王脩為孝廉。告高密縣為鄭玄特立一鄉，名為鄭公鄉。又國人無後，及四方游士有死亡者，皆為棺木而殯葬之。郡人甄子然孝行知名，早卒，融恨不及之，乃令配食縣社。其禮賢如此。在郡六年，劉備表融領青州刺史。建安元年，徵還為將作大匠，遷少府。每朝會訪對，輒為議主，諸卿大夫寄名而已。司馬彪九州春秋曰：融在北海，自以智能優贍，溢才命世，當時豪俊皆不能及。亦自許大志，且欲舉軍曜甲，與群賢要功，自於海岱結殖根本，不肯碌碌如平居郡守，事方伯、赴期會而已。然其所任用，好奇取異，皆輕剽之才。至于稽古之士，謬為恭敬，禮之雖備，不與論國事也。高密鄭玄，稱之鄭公，執子孫禮。及高談教令，盈溢官曹，辭氣溫雅，可玩而誦。論事考實，難可悉行。但能張磔網羅，其自理甚疏。租賦少稽，一朝殺五部督郵。姦民污吏，猾亂朝市，亦不能治。幽州精兵亂，至徐州，卒到城下，舉國皆恐。融直出說之，令無異志。遂與別校謀夜覆幽州，幽州軍敗，悉有其眾。無幾時，還復叛亡。黃巾將至，融大飲醇酒，躬自上馬，禦之淶水之上。寇令上部與融相拒，兩翼徑涉水，直到所治城。城潰，融不得入，轉至南縣，左右稍叛。連年傾覆，事無所濟，遂不能保鄣四境，棄郡而去。後徙徐州，以北海相自還領青州刺史，治郡北陲。欲附山東，外接遼東，得戎馬之利，建樹根本，孤立一隅，不與共也。于時曹、袁、公孫共相首尾，戰士不滿數百，穀不至萬斛。王子法、劉孔慈凶辯小才，信為腹心。左丞祖、劉義遜清雋之士，備在坐席而已，言此民望，不可失也。丞祖勸融自託彊國，融不聽而殺之。義遜棄去。遂為袁譚所攻，自春至夏，城小寇眾，流矢雨集。然融憑几安坐，讀書論議自若。城壞眾亡，身奔山東，室家為譚所虜。張璠漢紀曰：融在郡八年，僅以身免。帝初都許，融以為宜略依舊制，定王畿，正司隸所部為千里之封，乃引公卿上書言其義。是時天下草創，曹、袁之權未分，融所建明，不識時務。又天性氣爽，頗推平生之意，狎侮太祖。太祖制酒禁，而融書啁之曰：「天有酒旗之星，地列酒泉之郡，人有旨酒之德，故堯不飲千鍾，無以成其聖。且桀紂以色亡國，今令不禁婚姻也。」太祖外雖寬容，而內不能平。御史大夫郗慮知旨，以法免融官。歲餘，拜太中大夫。雖居家失勢，而賓客日滿其門，愛才樂酒，常歎曰：「坐上客常滿，樽中酒不空，吾無憂矣。」虎賁士有貌似蔡邕者，融每酒酣，輒引與同坐，曰：「雖無老成人，尚有典刑。」其好士如此。續漢書曰：太尉楊彪與袁術婚姻，術僭號，太祖與彪有隙，因是執彪，將殺焉。融聞之，不及朝服，往見太祖曰：「楊公累世清德，四葉重光，周書『父子兄弟，罪不相及』，況以袁氏之罪乎？易稱『積善餘慶』，但欺人耳。」太祖曰：「國家之意也。」融曰：「假使成王欲殺召公，則周公可得言不知邪？今天下纓緌搢紳之士所以瞻仰明公者，以明公聰明仁智，輔相漢朝，舉直措枉，致之雍熙耳。今橫殺無辜，則海內觀聽，誰不解體？孔融魯國男子，明日便當褰衣而去，不復朝矣。」太祖意解，遂理出彪。魏氏春秋曰：袁紹之敗也，融與太祖書曰：「武王伐紂，以妲己賜周公。」太祖以融學博，謂書傳所紀。後見，問之，對曰：「以今度之，想其當然耳！」十三年，融對孫權使，有訕謗之言，坐棄市。二子年八歲，時方弈棋，融被收，端坐不起。左右曰：「而父見執，不起何也？」二子曰：「安有巢毀而卵不破者乎！」遂俱見殺。融有高名清才，世多哀之。太祖懼遠近之議也，乃令曰：「太中大夫孔融既伏其罪矣，然世人多採其虛名，少於核實，見融浮豔，好作變異，眩其誑詐，不復察其亂俗也。此州人說平原禰衡受傳融論，以為父母與人無親，譬若缻器，寄盛其中，又言若遭饑饉，而父不肖，寧贍活餘人。融違天反道，敗倫亂理，雖肆市朝，猶恨其晚。更以此事列上，宣示諸軍將校掾屬，皆使聞見。」世語曰：融二子，皆齠齔。融見收，顧謂二子曰：「何以不辭？」二子俱曰：「父尚如此，復何所辭！」以為必俱死也。臣松之以為世語云融二子不辭，知必俱死，猶差可安。如孫盛之言，誠所未譬。八歲小兒，能玄了禍福，聰明特達，卓然既遠，則其憂樂之情，宜其有過成人，安有見父收執而曾無變容，弈棋不起，若在暇豫者乎？昔申生就命，言不忘父，不以己身將死而廢念父之情也。父安猶尚若茲，而況於顛沛哉？盛以此為美談，無乃賊夫人之子與！蓋由好奇情多，而不知言之傷理。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-7" id="annotation-7">[7]</a> Wèi lüè states: [Xǔ] Yōu appellation Zǐyuǎn, in youth with Yuán Shào and Tàizǔ were friends. During Chūpíng [190 - 194] he accompanied [Yuán] Shào to Jì Province, always in the seating mats advising and discussing. In the Guāndù campaign, he remonstrated [Yuán] Shào to not attack Tàizǔ, the story is in [Yuán] [Shào's biography](#06.qmd#yuanshao). [Yuán] Shào himself believed he was strong and flourishing, certainly wished to thoroughly use his military power. [Xǔ] Yōu knew he could not plan for him, and so deserted and went to Tàizǔ. [Yuán] Shào was defeated and fled, reaching later to capturing Jì Province, [Xǔ] Yōu had achievements. [Xǔ] Yōu himself relied on his accomplishments and labors, at times with Tàizǔ joked with one another, every time at the seats, he did not restrain himself, reaching to calling Tàizǔ by his childhood appellation, stating: "Mǒujiǎ,^[This is a placeholder term to avoid actually using Cáo Cāo's childhood appellation.] if you had not obtained me, you would not have obtained Jì Province." Tàizǔ laughed and said: "What you say is true." However inside he resented this. After this in following to walk out Yè's east gate, he looked back and spoke to his Left and Right stating: "If this family had not obtained me, then they would not be able to exit and enter these gates." Someone reported this, therefore he met with arrest.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏略曰：攸字子遠，少與袁紹及太祖善。初平中隨紹在冀州，嘗在坐席言議。官渡之役，諫紹勿與太祖相攻，語在紹傳。紹自以彊盛，必欲極其兵勢。攸知不可為謀，乃亡詣太祖。紹破走，及後得冀州，攸有功焉。攸自恃勳勞，時與太祖相戲，每在席，不自限齊，至呼太祖小字，曰：「某甲，卿不得我，不得冀州也。」太祖笑曰：「汝言是也。」然內嫌之。其後從行出鄴東門，顧謂左右曰：「此家非得我，則不得出入此門也。」人有白者，遂見收之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-8" id="annotation-8">[8]</a> Wèi lüè states: Lóu Guī appellation Zǐbó in youth with Tàizǔ had an old friendship. During Chūpíng [190 - 194] he was at Jīng Province's north border gathering multitudes, later went to join Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ appointed him a chief officer, did not send him to manage troops, always he was seated advising and discussing. Reaching to when the Hé's north was pacified and settled, he accompanied to Jì Province. After this when Tàizǔ with his various sons went out touring, Zǐbó at the time also accompanied. Zǐbó looked back and spoke to his Left and Right stating: "This family father and sons, to have delights like today." Someone reported this, Tàizǔ believed he had thoughts of hidden resentment, and therefore arrested and punished him.

Wú shū states: Zǐbó in youth had fierce ambition, once sighing and saying: "A man residing in the world should obtain several tens of thousands of troops and thousand cavalry at his back!" His peers laughed at him. Later in connection to hiding fugitives he was bound and about to die, was able to go over the prison walls and escape, the arresters pursued him urgently, Zǐbó then changed his clothes to appear as if helping the arresters, the clerks were not aware, therefore he was able to escape. It happened that Under Heaven Righteous Troops rose up, Zǐbó also gathered multitudes and depended on Liú Biǎo. Later he submitted to Cáo-gōng, and therefore was employed by him, army and state great planning he always participated in. Liú Biǎo died, Cáo-gōng headed toward Jīng Province, [Liú] Biǎo's son [Liú] Cóng surrendered, with Stave welcomed Cáo-gōng, the various officers all suspected a trick, Cáo-gōng asked Zǐbó about it, Zǐbó said: "Heaven's Under is in disturbance, each coveting Royal Mandates to dignify themselves, now coming with Stave, it certainly is utmost sincerity." Cáo-gōng said: "Very good." Therefore advanced troops. He favored and salaried Zǐbó, his family accumulated thousands in gold, he said: "Lóu Zǐbó is as wealthy and happy as me, only his power does not compare to mine." Followed in defeating Mǎ Chāo and the rest, Zǐbó's achievements were many. Cáo-gōng always sighed and said: "Zǐbó in planning, I do not match." Afterward he with Nán prefecture's Xí Shòu rode the same carriage, saw Cáo-gōng going out, [Xí] Shòu said: "Father and sons like this, how pleasing it is." Zǐbó said: "Living in the world, one should act for oneself, yet you merely watch other people?" [Xí] Shòu then reported this, therefore he met with execution.

Yú Huàn states: The ancients had a saying stating: "To get a bird, catch them with one net, however spreading one net for catching, in the end does not get a bird. The bird is able to distantly fly, distantly flying is by the strength of six quills, however without the assistance of many feathers, then the flight is not distant." By this considering it, in the creation of Great Wèi, although there were accomplished ministers, it also was not necessarily not because of the attachment of these sorts.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏略曰：婁圭字子伯，少與太祖有舊。初平中在荊州北界合眾，後詣太祖。太祖以為大將，不使典兵，常在坐席言議。及河北平定，隨在冀州。其後太祖從諸子出游，子伯時亦隨從。子伯顧謂左右曰：「此家父子，如今日為樂也。」人有白者，太祖以為有腹誹意，遂收治之。吳書曰：子伯少有猛志，嘗歎息曰：「男兒居世，會當得數萬兵千匹騎著後耳！」儕輩笑之。後坐藏亡命，被繫當死，得踰獄出，捕者追之急，子伯乃變衣服如助捕者，吏不能覺，遂以得免。會天下義兵起，子伯亦合眾與劉表相依。後歸曹公，遂為所用，軍國大計常與焉。劉表亡，曹公向荊州。表子琮降，以節迎曹公，諸將皆疑詐，曹公以問子伯。子伯曰：「天下擾攘，各貪王命以自重，今以節來，是必至誠。」曹公曰：「大善。」遂進兵。寵秩子伯，家累千金，曰：「婁子伯富樂于孤，但勢不如孤耳！」從破馬超等，子伯功為多。曹公常歎曰：「子伯之計，孤不及也。」後與南郡習授同載，見曹公出，授曰：「父子如此，何其快耶！」子伯曰：「居世間，當自為之，而但觀他人乎！」授乃白之，遂見誅。魚豢曰：古人有言曰：「得鳥者，羅之一目也，然張一目之羅，終不得鳥矣。鳥能遠飛，遠飛者，六翮之力也，然無眾毛之助，則飛不遠矣。」以此推之，大魏之作，雖有功臣，亦未必非茲輩胥附之由也。
:::
:::
:::

<a href="#source-9" id="annotation-9">[9]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Cuī] Yǎn's elder brother's grandson [Cuī] Liàng appellation Shìwén, for simplicity was praised, served Jìn as Secretariat Writer and Minister Herald.

Xún Chuò's Jìzhōu jì says [Cuī] Liàng was [Cuī] Yǎn's grandson.

〔四〕　世語曰：琰兄孫諒，字士文，以簡素稱，仕晉為尚書大鴻臚。荀綽冀州記云諒即琰之孫也。
:::
