## Máo Jiè {.unnumbered #maojie}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Máo Jiè appellation Xiàoxiān was a Chénliú Píngqiū man. In youth he was a county clerk, for purity and public-mindedness praised. About to flee the chaos to Jīng Province, he had not yet arrived, heard Liú Biǎo's government and orders were not enlightened, and therefore went to Lǔyáng. Tàizǔ oversaw Yǎn Province, recruited him as Manager Central Following Official. [Máo] Jiè spoke to Tàizǔ stating: "Now Heaven's Under is divided and collapsed, the state's ruler moved and shifted, the living people abandon their work, hungry and in famine wandering in exile, the public purse without reserves to last the year, the Hundred Surnames without the will for calm and stability, difficult to last for long. Now Yuán Shào and Liú Biǎo though have servicemen and civilians numerous and strong, both are without thorough far-reaching considerations, and have not planted foundations and established roots. In warfare the righteous win, holding position is by resources, it is appropriate to serve Heaven's Son to command the insubordinate, cultivate plowing and planting, accumulate army resources, in this way then the enterprise of hegemony can be achieved." Tàizǔ respectfully accepted his advice, transferred to Tent Office Merit Officer.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
毛玠字孝先，陳留平丘人也。少為縣吏，以清公稱。將避亂荊州，未至，聞劉表政令不明，遂往魯陽。太祖臨兗州，辟為治中從事。玠語太祖曰：「今天下分崩，國主遷移，生民廢業，饑饉流亡，公家無經歲之儲，百姓無安固之志，難以持久。今袁紹、劉表，雖士民眾彊，皆無經遠之慮，未有樹基建本者也。夫兵義者勝，守位以財，宜奉天子以令不臣，脩耕植，畜軍資，如此則霸王之業可成也。」太祖敬納其言，轉幕府功曹。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Tàizǔ was Excellency of Works and Assistant Chancellor, [Máo] Jiè always was East Department Assistant, with Cuī Yǎn together managing selections and nominations. Those that they nominated and employed were all pure and upright servicemen, although at the time there were those with flourishing reputation but with conduct not from the fundamentals, to the end none were able to advance. He attended to using frugality to lead people, because of this of the servicemen Under Heaven none did not use incorruptible integrity to encourage themselves, even ministers of nobility and favor, their carriages and dress did not dare exceed limits. Tàizǔ sighed and said: "Employing people like this, causing the people Under Heaven to govern themselves, what further is there for me to do?" When Emperor Wén was Five Office General, he personally visited [Máo] Jié to recommend those close to him. [Máo] Jiè answered stating: "Your Aged Servant by ability to maintain duties, by good fortune was able to escape faults. Now the people you speak off are not in the promotion sequence, therefore I do not dare follow the command." The main army returned to Yè, discussed what offices to merge and abolish. [Máo] Jiè did not grant favor requests, at the time people feared him, all wished to abolish the East Department. Thus they together reported stating: "In the old ways the West Department was the superior, the East Department was the next, it is appropriate to abolish the East Department." Tàizǔ knew their feelings, his Order stated: "The sun comes from the east, the moon waxes in the east, generally people in speaking of directions also have east first, how can we abolish the East Department?" Therefore he abolished the West Department. Previously, when Tàizǔ pacified Liǔchéng and distributed the captured items and goods, he specially had plain screen and plain support table bestowed on [Máo] Jiè, stating: "You sir have the airs of the ancients, therefore I bestow on you sir the furnishings of the ancients." [Máo] Jiè occupied prominent position, but always wore plain clothes and ate vegetables, fostered his orphaned elder brother's son with extreme sincerity, used his rewards and bestowments to distribute to the poor of his clan, his house had no surplus. Promoted to Right Army Preceptor. When Wèi state was first established, he became Secretariat Writers Deputy Director, again managing selections and nominations. <a href="#annotation-1" id="source-10">[10]</a> At the time the Heir-Apparent was not yet decided, and the Marquess of Línzī [Cáo] Zhí had favor, [Máo] Jiè secretly remonstrated stating: "Recently Yuán Shào, by not distinguishing between legitimate and illegitmate, overturned his clan and destroyed his state. Deposing and establishing is a great affair, not what should be inquired on." Later when the various bureaus gathered, [Máo] Jiè rose and changed clothes, Tàizǔ eyed and pointed stating: "This is what is called a state's Director of Correction, my Zhōu Chāng."^[Director of Correction (sīzhí) had been a Western Hàn office. Zhōu Chāng had been an official at the foundation of Western Hàn.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖為司空丞相，玠嘗為東曹掾，與崔琰並典選舉。其所舉用，皆清正之士，雖於時有盛名而行不由本者，終莫得進。務以儉率人，由是天下之士莫不以廉節自勵，雖貴寵之臣，輿服不敢過度。太祖歎曰：「用人如此，使天下人自治，吾復何為哉！」文帝為五官將，親自詣玠，屬所親眷。玠答曰：「老臣以能守職，幸得免戾，今所說人非遷次，是以不敢奉命。」大軍還鄴，議所并省。玠請謁不行，時人憚之，咸欲省東曹。乃共白曰：「舊西曹為上，東曹為次，宜省東曹。」太祖知其情，令曰：「日出於東，月盛於東，凡人言方，亦復先東，何以省東曹？」遂省西曹。初，太祖平柳城，班所獲器物，特以素屏風素馮几賜玠，曰：「君有古人之風，故賜君古人之服。」玠居顯位，常布衣蔬食，撫育孤兄子甚篤，賞賜以振施貧族，家無所餘。遷右軍師。魏國初建，為尚書僕射，復典選舉。〔一〕時太子未定，而臨菑侯植有寵，玠密諫曰：「近者袁紹以嫡庶不分，覆宗滅國。廢立大事，非所宜聞。」後群僚會，玠起更衣，太祖目指曰：「此古所謂國之司直，我之周昌也。」
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-10" id="annotation-10">[10]</a> Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Máo] Jiè was refined and bright, public-minded and upright, in office pure and scrupulous. His management of selections and nominations chose out the steadfast and true and removed the flowery and false, advanced modest conduct, restrained flattery and factionalism. Various management officials that in governing the people did not have achievements but yet had abundant private wealth were all dismissed and deposed, for a long time not selected and employed. At the time the Four Seas were compliant, none were not encouraged to (good) conduct. It reached then to chief clerks returning with dirty face and worn clothes, always riding crude carts. Army clerks in entering the offices walked on foot in Court dress. People imitated the simplicity of cooking pots, families emulated the integrity of washing tassels, the noble were without the implications of impure desires, the poor cut off seeking illicit goods, clerks were purified above, customs shifted below, the people to the present praised him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　先賢行狀曰：玠雅亮公正，在官清恪。其典選舉，拔貞實，斥華偽，進遜行，抑阿黨。諸宰官治民功績不著而私財豐足者，皆免黜停廢，久不選用。于時四海翕然，莫不勵行。至乃長吏還者，垢面羸衣，常乘柴車。軍吏入府，朝服徒行。人擬壺飧之絜，家象濯纓之操，貴者無穢欲之累，賤者絕姦貨之求，吏絜于上，俗移乎下，民到于今稱之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Cuī Yǎn had died, [Máo] Jiè inside was displeased. Later there was someone who reported [Máo] Jiè: "In going out and seeing the tattooed face rebels, their wives and children confiscated to be government slaves, [Máo] Jiè spoke stating: 'What caused Heaven to not rain probably was this.'"^[Lack of rain could be interpreted as an omen of injustice.] Tàizǔ was greatly furious, arrested [Máo] Jiè and sent to prison. Minister Judge Zhōng Yáo interrogated [Máo] Jiè stating: "Since the ancient sagely Emperors and enlightened Kings, punishments reached the wives and children. The Shū says: 'If left does not go left, right does not go right, I will then kill your children.'^[This quote is from the chapter Gān Shì in the Shàng Shū.] In the duties of the Director of Crimes, males enter into criminal servitude, females enter into grinding and husking. In Hàn law, the criminal's wives and children are confiscated to be slaves, faces tattooed. The punishments of tattoo ink enacted in Hàn law is preserved in ancient canon. Now true slaves have criminal ancestors, even after a hundred generations still they have tattooed faces and provide for the government, first to be lenient to the lives of the ordinary people, second to pardon the crimes of collective guilt. How is this to turn back on the intentions of the divine intelligence and so attract drought? Citing canons and plans,^[Canons (diǎn) and plans (móu) are two literary structures. Canon records the major affairs of the state, Plans record transcripts of advice on planning and strategy.] urgency always leads to coldness, laxity always leads to warmth, lenience then is excessive yáng, so that it causes drought. [Máo] Jiè^[Addressing Máo Jiè by his personal name is degrading, reflecting his status as an accused criminal.] in your spoken word, did you believe it lenience or did you believe it urgency? Urgency should be yīn and rain, how would it instead be drought. In Chéng Tāng's sagely reign the wilds still were without growing grass, when Zhōu Xuān was a good ruler, the drought demon still brought disaster. From the excessive drought onward, it has accumulated to thirty years, to assign the blame to tattooed faces, is it fitting or not? When the Wèi men attacked Xíng, the brigrades mobilized yet there was rain, crimes and evils without verification, how did it answer Heaven? [Máo] Jiè your words of ridicule and slander flowed to lower people, the sounds of displeasure above reached the sagely hearing. [Máo] Jiè in your spit out words, the situation was not of speaking alone, at the time of seeing the tattooed faces, altogether there were how many people? The tattooed face slaves, did you know them? What reason did you have to see and face them speaking sighs? At the time who did you speak with? In meeting with answers what was said? On what day and moon? At what location? The matter is already exposed, you cannot hide or deceive, reply with the entire situation." [Máo] Jiè said: "Your servant has heard that Xiāo-shēng hangled himself due to the distress from Shí Xiǎn,^[Xiāo Wàngzhī was a Western Hàn powerful minister who was slandered by the eunuch Shí Xiǎn and imprisoned, and committed suicide while in prison.] when Jiǎ-zǐ was exiled the slander was by Jiàng and Guàn,^[Jiǎ Yì was a Western Hàn statesman who was exiled after being slandered by the Marquess of Jiàng Zhōu Bó and Guàn Yīng.] Bái Qǐ was bestowed sword at Dùyóu,^[Bái Qǐ was a Warring States era Qín General who was forced to commit suicide through the bestowal of a sword.] Cháo Cuò was delivered to execution at the East Market,^[Cháo Cuò was a Western Hàn strategist who led the programs to weaken the powerful vassal states of Hàn. This led to the Seven States rebellion, and Cháo Cuò was executed by Hàn Emperor Jǐng in an attempt to appease the rebels.] Wǔ Yuán's life ended at Wú capital.^[Wǔ Yuán was a Spring and Autumn era statesman of Wú state who was slandered and ordered to commit suicide.] These varoius sirs, some were envied before, some were harmed later. Your Servant from shedding milk teeth and holding writing strips, accumulated diligence to take office, duties near to the critical, where human affairs intrude. When private requests were made to Your Servant, no situations were not cut off, when injustices were reported to Your Servant, no details were not investigated. Human nature lusts for profit, and is prohibited by law, law prohibits profit, power and capability harms it. Black flies grow without restraint, and make slander of Your Servant, the people that slander Your Servant, the situation is no other. In the past Wángshū Chénshēng fought to rectify the Royal Court, Xuān-zǐ judged the case, mandated the raising of contracts, right and wrong had their appropriateness, crooked and straight had their places, the Chūnqiū commended this, and therefore wrote of it.^[For the case of Wángshū Chénshēng and Xuān-zǐ's judgment, see the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Xiāng Tenth Year.] Your Servant did not say this, there was no time or person. To say that Your Servant said this, certainly there would be verification and proof. I beg to immersed in the investigation of Xuān-zǐ, and request the reply of Wángshū. If Your Servant is heart to be wrong, on the day of punishment, I would compare it to the gift of secure carriage, the coming of a bestowed sword, I would compare to the kindness of a heavy reward. I solemnly reply with the situation." At the time Huán Jiē and Hé Qià advanced to speak and rescued [Máo] Jiè. [Máo] Jiè therefore was dismissed, died at home. <a href="#annotation-11" id="source-11">[11]</a> Tàizǔ bestowed coffin and equipment, money and silk, appointed his son [Máo] Jī as a Cadet Central.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
崔琰既死，玠內不悅。後有白玠者：「出見黥面反者，其妻子沒為官奴婢，玠言曰『使天不雨者蓋此也』。」太祖大怒，收玠付獄。大理鍾繇詰玠曰：「自古聖帝明王，罪及妻子。書云：『左不共左，右不共右，予則孥戮女。』司寇之職，男子入于罪隸，女子入于舂稿。漢律，罪人妻子沒為奴婢，黥面。漢法所行黥墨之刑，存於古典。今真奴婢祖先有罪，雖歷百世，猶有黥面供官，一以寬良民之命，二以宥并罪之辜。此何以負於神明之意，而當致旱？案典謀，急恆寒若，舒恆燠若，寬則亢陽，所以為旱。玠之吐言，以為寬邪，以為急也？急當陰霖，何以反旱？成湯聖世，野無生草，周宣令主，旱魃為虐。亢旱以來，積三十年，歸咎黥面，為相值不？衛人伐邢，師興而雨，罪惡無徵，何以應天？玠譏謗之言，流於下民，不悅之聲，上聞聖聽。玠之吐言，勢不獨語，時見黥面，凡為幾人？黥面奴婢，所識知邪？何緣得見，對之歎言？時以語誰？見答云何？以何日月？於何處所？事已發露，不得隱欺，具以狀對。」玠曰：「臣聞蕭生縊死，困於石顯；賈子放外，讒在絳、灌；白起賜劍於杜郵；晁錯致誅於東市；伍員絕命於吳都：斯數子者，或妒其前，或害其後。臣垂齠執簡，累勤取官，職在機近，人事所竄。屬臣以私，無勢不絕，語臣以冤，無細不理。人情淫利，為法所禁，法禁于利，勢能害之。青蠅橫生，為臣作謗，謗臣之人，勢不在他。昔王叔、陳生爭正王廷，宣子平理。命舉其契，是非有宜，曲直有所，春秋嘉焉，是以書之。臣不言此，無有時、人。說臣此言，必有徵要。乞蒙宣子之辨，而求王叔之對。若臣以曲聞，即刑之日，方之安駟之贈；賜劍之來，比之重賞之惠。謹以狀對。」時桓階、和洽進言救玠。玠遂免黜，卒于家。〔一〕太祖賜棺器錢帛，拜子機郎中。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-11" id="annotation-11">[11]</a> Sūn Shèng states: Wèi Wǔ in this failed in governance and punishment. The Yì praises clearly deciding all prison cases, the Zhuàn has raising the straight and stopping the crooked. All prison cases clarified then the state is without resentful people, the crooked and straight handled then of the people none do not submit. There has never been belief in the superficial sounds of black flies and trust in the permeation of slanderous complaints that could justly manage the Four Seas and summon pure and fine prosperity. In the past Hàn Gāo imprisoned Xiāo Hé, released him and restored him as Chancellor, [Máo] Jiè after one reproach forever met with expulsion and exile. The two rulers in their tolerance and magnanimity, how are they not different?
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　孫盛曰：魏武於是失政刑矣。易稱「明折庶獄」，傳有「舉直措枉」，庶獄明則國無怨民，枉直當則民無不服，未有徵青蠅之浮聲，信浸潤之譖訴，可以允釐四海，惟清緝熙者也。昔者漢高獄蕭何，出復相之，玠之一責，永見擯放，二主度量，豈不殊哉！
:::
:::
:::

## Xú Yì {.unnumbered #xuyi}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Xú Yì appellation Jìcái was a Dōngguǎn man. He fled the troubles to the Jiāng's east, Sūn Cè with courtesies recruited him, [Xún] Yì changed his family name and personal name, in disguise returned to his home prefecture. Tàizǔ as Excellency of Works recruited him as an assistant associate. Followed the western campaign against Mǎ Chāo, [Mǎ] Chāo was defeated, the army returned. At the time Guānzhōng had newly submitted, not yet extremely secure, left [Xú] Yì as Assistant Chancellor's Chief Scribe, defending and succoring the western capital, the western capital praised his prestige and faith. Transferred to Yōng Province Inspector. Again returned as East Department Associate. Dīng Yí and others met with favor at the time, all hated him, but [Xú] Yì to the end did not move because of them. <a href="#annotation-12" id="source-12">[12]</a> Sent out as Wèi Prefecture Administrator. When Tàizǔ campaigned against Sūn Quán, transferred to Remaining Office Chief Scribe, spoke to [Xú] Yì stating: "Sir your loyalty and brightness the ancients could not surpass, however you are slightly too strict. In the past Xīmén Bào girdled leather to loosen himself. The ability to use the soft and weak to control the hard and strong, is what I hope of you sir. Now sending you sir to preside over remaining affairs, I will have no further worries of looking back." When Wèi state was established, became Secretariat Writer, further managing selections and nominations, promoted to Secretariat Writers Director.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
徐奕字季才，東莞人也。避難江東，孫策禮命之。奕改姓名，微服還本郡。太祖為司空，辟為掾屬，從西征馬超。超破，軍還。時關中新服，未甚安，留奕為丞相長史，鎮撫西京，西京稱其威信。轉為雍州刺史，復還為東曹屬。丁儀等見寵於時，並害之，而奕終不為動。〔一〕出為魏郡太守。太祖征孫權，徙為留府長史，謂奕曰：「君之忠亮，古人不過也，然微太嚴。昔西門豹佩韋以自緩，夫能以柔弱制剛彊者，望之於君也。今使君統留事，孤無復還顧之憂也。」魏國既建，為尚書，復典選舉，遷尚書令。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-12" id="annotation-12">[12]</a> Wèi shū states: Someone spoke to [Xú] Yì stating: "The directness of Shǐ Yú, how does it compare to the wisdom of Qú Bóyù? Dīng Yí is currently noble and valued, it is appropriate to consider how to defer to him." [Xú] Yì states: "With his Excellency's enlightened sagacity, how can [Dīng] Yí be able to enact his falseness for long? Moreover one who uses treachery to serve lord, I am capable of resisting. How can you sir have a different plan for me?"

Fù-zǐ states: Wǔ Huángdì was utmostly enlightened, Cuī Yǎn and Xú Yì were the era's pure worthies, both for loyalty and faith were prominent in the Wèi Court. Dīng Yí came between them, Xú Yì lost his position and Cuī Yǎn was executed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：或謂奕曰：「夫以史魚之直，孰與蘧伯玉之智？丁儀方貴重，宜思所以下之。」奕曰：「以公明聖，儀豈得久行其偽乎！且姦以事君者，吾所能禦也，子寧以他規我。」傅子曰：武皇帝，至明也。崔琰、徐奕，一時清賢，皆以忠信顯於魏朝；丁儀閒之，徐奕失位而崔琰被誅。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Tàizǔ campaigned against Hànzhōng, Wèi Fěng and others rebelled, Central Commandant Yáng Jùn was demoted. Tàizǔ sighed and said: "That [Wèi] Fěng dared conceive a rebellious heart, was because my claw and teeth ministers were without any that could restrain treachery and guard against schemes. How can I obtain someone like Zhūgě Fēng to send to succeed [Yáng] Jùn?" Huán Jiē said: "Xú Yì is that person." Tàizǔ then appointed [Xú] Yì as Central Commandant. The hand-written Order said: "In the past Chǔ had Zǐyù and Duke Wén sat on side mat for him, Jí Àn was at Court and Huáinán abandoned his schemes because of him. The Shī praising 'The country's Director of Uprightness' speaks of you sir." He was in office for several moons, was critically ill and requested to retire, appointed Remonstration Consultant Grandee, died. <a href="#annotation-13" id="source-13">[13]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖征漢中，魏諷等謀反，中尉楊俊左遷。太祖歎曰：「諷所以敢生亂心，以吾爪牙之臣無遏姦防謀者故也。安得如諸葛豐者，使代俊乎！」桓階曰：「徐奕其人也。」太祖乃以奕為中尉，手令曰：「昔楚有子玉，文公為之側席而坐；汲黯在朝，淮南為之折謀。詩稱『邦之司直』，君之謂與！」在職數月，疾篤乞退，拜諫議大夫，卒。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-13" id="annotation-13">[13]</a> Wèi shū states: Every time Emperor Wén with the Court ministers gathered together, never once did he not sigh, thinking of [Xú] Yì's conduct as a man. [Xú] Yì was without sons, Edict appointed his cousin's son [Xú] Tǒng as a Cadet, to serve as [Xú] Yì's posterity.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：文帝每與朝臣會同，未嘗不嗟歎，思奕之為人。奕無子，詔以其族子統為郎，以奉奕後。
:::
:::
:::

## Hé Kuí {.unnumbered #hekui}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Hé Kuí appellation Shūlóng was a Chén prefecture Yángxià man. His great-grandfather [Hé] Xī in Hàn Emperor Ān's time in office reached Chariots and Cavalry General. <a href="#annotation-14" id="source-14">[14]</a> [Hé] Kuí as a child lost his father, lived with his mother's elder brother, for filial peity and fraternal friendliness was praised. Height eight chǐ three cùn,^[About 1.9 meters.] his appearance was dignified and stern. <a href="#annotation-15" id="source-15">[15]</a> He fled the chaos to the Huái's south. Later Yuán Shù reached Shòuchūn, recruited him, [Hé] Kuí did not answer, however he therefore was by [Yuán] Shù detained. Long after this, [Yuán] Shù with Qiáo Ruí together attacked and besieged Qíyáng,^[Qíyáng city was in Qí county in Pèi state.] Qíyáng was by Tàizǔ firmly defended. [Yuán] Shù because [Hé] Kuí was a man of that prefecture wished to send him to persuade Qíyáng. [Hé] Kuí spoke to [Yuán] Shù's strategy minister Lǐ Yè stating: "In the past Liǔ Xiàhuì heard the plan to attack a state and had anxious expression, stating: 'I have heard that attacks on a state do not ask benevolent men, how did this speech reach to me?'" Therefore he fled to hide in Qián mountain. [Yuán] Shù knew [Hé] Kuí to the end would not be employed by him, and so stopped. [Yuán] Shù's elder cousin Shānyáng Administrator [Yuán] Yí's mother was [Hé] Kuí's cousin's aunt, therefore although he resented [Hé] Kuí yet he did not apply harm.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
何夔字叔龍，陳郡陽夏人也。曾祖父熙，漢安帝時官至車騎將軍。〔一〕夔幼喪父，與母兄居，以孝友稱。長八尺三寸，容貌矜嚴。〔二〕避亂淮南。後袁術至壽春，辟之，夔不應，然遂為術所留。久之，術與橋蕤俱攻圍蘄陽，蘄陽為太祖固守。術以夔彼郡人，欲脅令說蘄陽。夔謂術謀臣李業曰：「昔柳下惠聞伐國之謀而有憂色，曰『吾聞伐國不問仁人，斯言何為至于我哉』！」遂遁匿灊山。術知夔終不為己用，乃止。術從兄山陽太守遺母，夔從姑也，是以雖恨夔而不加害。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-14" id="annotation-14">[14]</a> Huà Jiào's Hàn shū states: [Hé] Xī appellation Mèngsūn, in youth had great ambition, not restrained by petty limits. His body height was eight chǐ five cùn, form and appearance imposingand sturdy, excelled in bearing and presentation. Nominated Filial-Incorruptible, became Visitor, assessing courtesies inside the Palace Halls, his voice moving the Left and Right. Emperor Hé was impressed with him, successively ranked Director of Retainers Colonel, Minister of Agriculture. Yǒngchū Third Year [109], the Southern Chányú with the Wūhuán both rebelled, appointed [Hé] Xī as Acting Chariots and Cavalry General to campaign against them, repeatedly had achievements. The Wūhuán requested to surrender, the Chányú again declared himself servant as before. It happened that [Hé] Xī suddenly fell ill and died.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　華嶠漢書曰：熙字孟孫，少有大志，不拘小節。身長八尺五寸，體貌魁梧，善為容儀。舉孝廉，為謁者，贊拜殿中，音動左右。和帝（佳）〔偉〕之，歷位司隸校尉、大司農。永初三年，南單于與烏丸俱反，以熙行車騎將軍征之，累有功。烏丸請降，單于復稱臣如舊。會熙暴疾卒。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-15" id="annotation-15">[15]</a> Wèi shū states: At Hàn's end the castrate officials controlled affairs, [Hé] Kuí's cousin's father [Hé] Héng was a Secretariat Writer, had direct speech, because of this was targeted as a factionalist, all his fathers and elder brothers were all proscribed. [Hé] Kuí sighed and said: "Heaven and Earth is closed off, worthy men go into hiding." Therefore he did not answer the recruitments of the managing directors.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：漢末閹宦用事，夔從父衡為尚書，有直言，由是在黨中，諸父兄皆禁錮。夔歎曰：「天地閉，賢人隱。」故不應宰司之命。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Jiàn'ān Second Year [197], [Hé] Kuí was about to return to his hometown, judged that [Yuán] Shù certainly would urgently pursue, and so secretly traveled and was able to escape, the next year arriving at his home prefecture. Shortly after this, Tàizǔ recruited him as an Excellency of Work's assistant associate. At the time there was rumor that Yuán Shù's army was in chaos, Tàizǔ asked [Hé] Kuí stating: "Do you sir believe it or not?" [Hé] Kuí replied stating: "Those that Heaven assists are the obedient, those that humans assist are the faithful. [Yuán] Shù is without the substance of faith or obedience, yet hopes for the assistance of Heaven and humanity, this is to be unable to achieve his ambitions Under Heaven. A ruler who has lost morality, even their close kin rebel against them, so all the more for their Left and Right. By [me, Hé] Kuí observing it, their chaos is certain." Tàizǔ said: "The state that loses its worthies then falls. You sir would not be employed by [Yuán] Shù. Is their chaos not also appropriate?" Tàizǔ by nature was strict, in public affairs of his assistants and associates, there tended to be application of beatings. [Hé] Kuí always kept poison, vowing to die instead of suffer disgrace, therefore to the end it did not reach to that. <a href="#annotation-16" id="source-16">[16]</a> Sent out as Chéngfù Magistrate.^[Chéngfù county was in Rǔnán prefecture.] <a href="#annotation-17" id="source-17">[17]</a> Promoted to Chángguǎng Administrator.^[Chángguǎng had formerly been a county in Dōnglái prefecture, later split off to form a new Chángguǎng prefecture.] The prefecture bordered the mountains and sea, the Huángjīn were not yet pacified, of powerful figures many were in rebellion, and Yuán Tán gave them office positions. Chángguǎng county man Guǎng Chéng had follower multitudes of over three thousand families, acting as a bandit harm. Those discussing wished to raise troops to attack him. [Hé] Kuí said: "[Guǎn] Chéng and the rest were not born delighing in chaos, they are accustomed to chaos, not able to return on their own, not yet given virtuous instruction, therefore they do not know to return to the good. Now if the troops press them urgently, they will fear extermination, and certainly join forces to battle. Attacking them is already not yet easy to capture them, and even if there is victory, it certainly will wound the clerks and civilians. It is not as good as gently persuading with grace and virtue, to cause them to feel self regret, and we can without bothering the troops yet settle them." Thus he sent Prefecture Deputy Huáng Zhēn to go, explained the success and failures to them, [Guǎn] Chéng and the rest all requested to submit. [Hé] Kuí sent his clerk Chéng Hóng as designate Colonel and the Chángguǎng County Deputy and others in the suburbs to welcome and present ox and alcohol, visited the prefecture. Also pacified bandit Cóng Qián, the multitudes also several thousand, [Hé] Kuí led the prefecture troops with Zhāng Liáo to together suppress and settle them. Dōngmóu man Wáng Yíng, multitudes of over three thousand families, coerced Chāngyáng county into rebellion. [Hé] Kuí sent his clerk Wáng Qīn and others, gave them plans and strategies to have them to divide and disperse them. In ten days to a moon all were pacified and settled.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
建安二年，夔將還鄉里，度術必急追，乃閒行得免，明年到本郡。頃之，太祖辟為司空掾屬。時有傳袁術軍亂者，太祖問夔曰；「君以為信不？」夔對曰：「天之所助者順，人之所助者信。術無信順之實，而望天人之助，此不可以得志於天下。夫失道之主，親戚叛之，而況於左右乎！以夔觀之，其亂必矣。」太祖曰；「為國失賢則亡。君不為術所用；亂，不亦宜乎！」太祖性嚴，掾屬公事，往往加杖；夔常畜毒藥，誓死無辱，是以終不見及。〔一〕出為城父令。〔二〕遷長廣太守。郡濱山海，黃巾未平，豪傑多背叛，袁譚就加以官位。長廣縣人管承，徒眾三千餘家，為寇害。議者欲舉兵攻之。夔曰：「承等非生而樂亂也，習於亂，不能自還，未被德教，故不知反善。今兵迫之急，彼恐夷滅，必并力戰。攻之既未易拔，雖勝，必傷吏民，不如徐喻以恩德，使容自悔，可不煩兵而定。」乃遣郡丞黃珍往，為陳成敗，承等皆請服。夔遣吏成弘領校尉，長廣縣丞等郊迎奉牛酒，詣郡。矣平賊從錢，眾亦數千，夔率郡兵與張遼共討定之。東牟人王營，眾三千餘家，脅昌陽縣為亂。夔遣吏王欽等，授以計略，使離散之。旬月皆平定。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-18" id="annotation-18">[18]</a> Sūn Shèng states: The lord employs the servant with ritual, the servant serves the lord with loyalty, therefore above and below are serene and harmonious, the way shines and moral transformation permeates. The Offices of the Excellencies assistants and associates are the trained servicemen of antiquity, certainly selected from the eminent of the time, gathered and raised from the outstanding and excellent, obtaining the persons then responsibilities of discussing the ways flourishes, if lacking the talent then the danger of overturning pots arrives. If there are blemishes and quarrels, punishing by expulsion is permissible. Applying the penalties of beating, purging through the warnings of small punishments, how is that the meaning of the saying 'guiding them by virtue, aligning them by ritual?' Thus the going out or retiring of servicemen^[Going out (chū) or retiring (chù) refer to the options of going to serve in public office, or retiring to a private life.] should measure virtue by stepping toe, the integrity of possible or not, certainly must be careful in where they tread. Therefore the lofty and esteemed sorts, raise their hearts to the top of the azure clouds, how could they be what Kings and Lords could force to be subjects, what fame and vessels could restrain and bind? If one is not of this group, placing oneself in worldly dirt, then evils or serenity, glory or disgrace, are determined by the times. Therefore Jī-zǐ was calm at the execution of his offspring, Liǔ Xiàyí at his three expulsions, Xiāo Hé and Zhōu Bó also were bound and leashed, how was it not disgrace? It was because their lord mandated it. [Hé] Kuí understood the systems of the time, but greedily clung to favors, clutching poison to coerce his lord, to avoid a trifling humiliation. The Shī says: 'Oh this narrow heart,'^[This appears to be a variant of a line in the song Gě Jù in the Shījīng.] Hé Kuí had this. Exiling him was permissible, pardoning him was wrong.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　孫盛曰：夫君使臣以禮，臣事君以忠，是以上下休嘉，道光化洽。公府掾屬，古之造士也，必擢時雋，搜揚英逸，得其人則論道之任隆，非其才則覆餗之患至。苟有疵釁，刑黜可也。加其捶扑之罰，肅以小懲之戒，豈「導之以德，齊之以禮」之謂與！然士之出處，宜度德投趾；可不之節，必審於所蹈。故高尚之徒，抗心於青雲之表，豈王侯之所能臣，名器之所羈紲哉！自非此族，委身世塗，否泰榮辱，制之由時，故箕子安於孥戮，柳下夷於三黜，蕭何、周勃亦在縲紲，夫豈不辱，君命故也。夔知時制，而甘其寵，挾藥要君，以避微恥。詩云「唯此褊心」，何夔其有焉。放之，可也；宥之，非也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-19" id="annotation-19">[19]</a> Wèi shū states: From since after Liú Bèi had rebelled, the southeast had many disturbances. Tàizǔ appointed Chén Qún as Zàn Magistrate, [Hé] Kuí as Chéngfù Magistrate, the various counties all employed famed servicemen to calm and succor them, from then afterward the clerks and civilians were gradually settled.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：自劉備叛後，東南多變。太祖以陳群為酇令，夔為城父令，諸縣皆用名士以鎮撫之，其後吏民稍定。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
At that time Tàizǔ first established a new legal code sent down to the provinces and prefectures, and also collected taxes of silk and cloth. [Hé] Kuí believed his prefecture was newly established, near to the rear of the brigades, and could not be suddenly bound by law, and so sent up report stating: "From since the disaster and chaos onward, the people lost their place, now although there is slight calm, however the days of submission to instruction is still shallow. The sent down new legal code all uses clear punishments and strict law to align and unify great moral transformation. The six counties I govern, the territory is newly settled, and moreover have hunger and famine, if it is entirely aligned with the legal code prohibitions, I fear perhaps there will be those that do not follow instructions. Those that do not follow instructions cannot be not executed, then this is not the intention to observe the people and establish instructions in accordance to the times. The Former Kings distinguished the taxation of Nine Regions to differentiate the far and near, systemized the punishments of three statues to pacify and govern chaos, I humbly believe this prefecture should comply with the standards for a distant territory and new country, in minor affairs among the people, have the chief clerks observe the times and follow what is appropriate, above to not turn back on the correct law, below to follow the hearts of the Hundred Surnames. Within three years, the people will be secure in their work, afterward aligning them with the law, then nowhere will not be reached." Tàizǔ followed this advice. Summoned to return as Advisor to the Assistant Chancellor's Army Affairs. Sea pirate Guō Zǔ plundered and raided the borders of Lè'ān and Jǐnán, the province and prefectures suffered from it. Tàizǔ because [Hé] Kuí formerly at Chángguǎng had prestige and faith appointed him Lè'ān Administrator. Arriving in office in several moons the various cities were all pacified.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
是時太祖始制新科下州郡，又收租稅綿絹。夔以郡初立，近以師旅之後，不可卒繩以法，乃上言曰：「自喪亂已來，民人失所，今雖小安，然服教日淺。所下新科，皆以明罰敕法，齊一大化也。所領六縣，疆域初定，加以饑饉，若一切齊以科禁，恐或有不從教者。有不從教者不得不誅，則非觀民設教隨時之意也。先王辨九服之賦以殊遠近，制三典之刑以平治亂，愚以為此郡宜依遠域新邦之典，其民間小事，使長吏臨時隨宜，上不背正法，下以順百姓之心。比及三年，民安其業，然後齊之以法，則無所不至矣。」太祖從其言。徵還，參丞相軍事。海賊郭祖寇暴樂安、濟南界，州郡苦之。太祖以夔前在長廣有威信，拜樂安太守。到官數月，諸城悉平。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Entered as Assistant Chancellor's East Department Assistant. [Hé] Kuí's advice to Tàizǔ stated: "From since the rising of armies onward, institution systems are still rudimentary, the employment of people is not yet comprehensive of their fundamentals, therefore each recommend their own groups, at times forgetting mortality and virtue. [I, Hé] Kuí have heard that when regulation of rank is by worthiness, then the people are cautious of virtue, and when regulation of salary is by use, then the people rise to labor. I believe that from now on employments must first verify them by their villages and communities, have the older and younger follow ordering, and not overstep one another. Make prominent the rewards for loyalty and uprightness, make clear the repayment for true public-mindness, then the divide between the worthy and degenerate will naturally be distinguished. Also we can prepare orders to guard against nominations not being by substance, having the relevant managers separately receive the responsibility. The ministers at Court at times receive instructions with the Departments to together make selections, each assigned their responsibilities. Above it will observe the integrity of the Court ministers, below it will block the origins of competition, to supervise the various subordinates, to lead all peoples, in this way then Heaven's Under would be extremely fortunate." Tàizǔ praised it as good. When Wèi state was established, appointed Secretariat Writers Deputy Director. <a href="#annotation-20" id="source-20">[20]</a> Emperor Wén became Heir-Apparent, with Liáng Mào as his Grand Tutor, [Hé] Kuí as his Junior Tutor. Specially mandated the two Tutors with the Secretariat Writers East Department to together select the office associates of the Heir-Apparent and various lords. When [Liáng] Mào died, had [Hé] Kuí succeed [Liáng] Mào. Every first day of the moon, the Grand Tutor entered to meet the Heir-Apparent, the Heir-Apparent in formal regulation uniforms pay respects, on other days there were no meeting ceremonies. [Hé] Kuí was promoted to Minister Charioteer, the Heir-Apparent wished to bid farewell with him, in the night making preparations. [Hé] Kuí was without intention to go, thus he wrote a letter to invite him. [Hé] Kuí because the state had constant regulations therefore did not go. His adherence to the correct was like this. However in an era of frugality, he was the most extravagant and lavish. When Emperor Wén ascended the throne, enfeoffed Marquess of Chéngyáng precinct, estate three hundred households. He fell ill and repeatedly requested to resign position. Edict replied stating: "Overall courtesy to worthies and closeness to old friendships is the constant work of Emperors and Kings. In closeness then you sir have merits of supporting assistance, in worthiness then you sir have abundance of purity and firmness. Those that have hidden virtue must have clear reply, now you sir are ill and though not yet recovered, the divine intelligence hears of it. You sir are thus to rest, to follow Our intentions." Died, posthumous name called Marquess Jìng. His son [Hé] Zēng succeeded, during Xiánxī became Excellency over the Masses. <a href="#annotation-21" id="source-21">[21]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
入為丞相東曹掾。夔言於太祖曰：「自軍興以來，制度草創，用人未詳其本，是以各引其類，時忘道德。夔聞以賢制爵，則民慎德；以庸制祿，則民興功。以為自今所用，必先核之鄉閭，使長幼順敘，無相踰越。顯忠直之賞，明公實之報，則賢不肖之分，居然別矣。又可脩保舉故不以實之令，使有司別受其負。在朝之臣，時受教與曹並選者，各任其責。上以觀朝臣之節，下以塞爭競之源，以督群下，以率萬民，如是則天下幸甚。」太祖稱善。魏國既建，拜尚書僕射〔一〕。文帝為太子，以涼茂為太傅，夔為少傅；特命二傅與尚書東曹並選太子諸侯官屬。茂卒，以夔代茂。每月朔，太傅入見太子，太子正法服而禮焉；他日無會儀。夔遷太僕，太子欲與辭，宿戒供，夔無往意；乃與書請之，夔以國有常制，遂不往。其履正如此。然於節儉之世，最為豪汰。文帝踐阼，封成陽亭侯，邑三百戶。疾病，屢乞遜位。詔報曰：「蓋禮賢親舊，帝王之常務也。以親則君有輔弼之勳焉，以賢則君有醇固之茂焉。夫有陰德者必有陽報，今君疾雖未瘳，神明聽之矣。君其即安，以順朕意。」薨，諡曰靖侯。子曾嗣，咸熙中為司徒。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-20" id="annotation-20">[20]</a> Wèi shū states: At the time Dīng Yí and his brothers were then advancing in favor, [Dīng] Yí with [Hé] Kuí were not harmonious. Secretariat Writer Fù Xùn spoke ot [Hé] Kuí stating: "[Dīng] Yí's dislike of you is already extreme. You are friends with Máo Jiè. [Máo] Jiè and the rest, [Dīng] Yí has already harmed them. You should slightly defer to him!" [Hé] Kuí said: "To be unrighteous is only sufficient to harm oneself, how is it capable of harming others? Moreover harboring a treacherous flattering heart, standing in an enlightened Court, can he last for long?" [Hé] Kuí to the end would not subdue his intentions, [Dīng] Yí later indeed due to viciousness and falseness was destroyed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：時丁儀兄弟方進寵，儀與夔不合。尚書傅巽謂夔曰：「儀不相好已甚，子友毛玠，玠等儀已害之矣。子宜少下之！」夔曰：「為不義適足害其身，焉能害人？且懷姦佞之心，立於明朝，其得久乎！」夔終不屈志，儀後果以凶偽敗。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-21" id="annotation-21">[21]</a> Gān Bǎo's Jìn jì states: [Hé] Zēng appellation Yǐngkǎo. During Zhèngyuán became Director of Retainers Colonel. At the time Guànqiū Jiǎn's granddaughter was married to the Liú clan, due to pregnancy was bound in the Ministry of Justice. The girl's mother was a Xún, Martial Guard General Xún Yǐ memorialized to spare her, she had already been spared, declined and visited the Minister of Justice, begging to become a government slave to ransom her daughter's life. [Hé] Zēng had his Registrar Chéng Xián make a discussion, the discussion stated: "Great Wèi continues the flaws of Qín and Hàn, not yet having time to reform regulations. The reason for pursuing to execute already married off daughters, is truly to wish to exterminate the clans of evil sorts. If they are already pregnant, then they become the mother of another family. In prevention then it is not sufficient to punish the source of treachery and chaos, in emotion then it wounds the thoughts of a filial child. Males do not suffer the punishments of other clans, but females alone are ensnared to execution in two families. This is not the way to mourn and pity the vulnerability of women or balance the great divisions of law regulations. Your Servant believes that women at home can follow the punishment of father and mother, and wives that have already completed the ceremony follow the execution of the husband's family." The Court followed this, thus settled the legal code statues.

Jìn Zhūgōng zàn states: [Hé] Zēng for loftiness and refinement was praised, and moreover by nature was pure and filial, position reached Grand Governor,^[During Jìn, Grand Governor (tàizǎi) replaced Grand Preceptor (tàishī) due to the name taboo of Sīmǎ Shī.] enfeoffed Duke of Lǎnglíng county. Aged over eighty he died, posthumous name called Duke Yuán. His son [Hé] Shào succeeded. [Hé] Shào appellation Jìngzǔ had talent and insight deep and wide, and possessed the form and ceremony to govern states. Rank also reached Grand Governor, posthumous name Duke Kāng. hIs son [Hé] Ruí succeeded. [Hé] Shào's concubine-born elder brother [Hé] Zūn appellation Sīzǔ had competence and ability, in youth went through pure duties, ended as Minister Charioteer. [Hé] Zūn's son [Hé] Suì appellation Bóyù also for competence in affairs was praised. During Yǒngjiā [307 - 313] became Secretariat Writer, was killed by Sīmǎ Yuè.

Fù-zǐ appraises [Hé] Zēng with Xún Yǐ stating: "Those that used the ways of King Wén to serve their kin, were they Yǐngchāng's Marquess Hé and Marquess Xún? The ancients praised Zēng and Mǐn, the present speak of Xún and Hé. Inside they exhausted their hearts to serve their kin, outside esteemed courtesy and deference to connect to Heaven's Under. Filial sons are the exemplars for a hundred generations, benevolent men are the finest of Heaven's Under. Those cpaable of enacting the way of benevolence and filial piety, are the model examples for noble men."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　干寶晉紀曰：曾字穎考。正元中為司隸校尉。時毌丘儉孫女適劉氏，以孕繫廷尉。女母荀，為武衛將軍荀顗所表活，既免，辭詣廷尉，乞為官婢以贖女命。曾使主簿程咸為議，議曰：「大魏承奏、漢之弊，未及革制。所以追戮已出之女，誠欲殄醜類之族也。若已產育，則成他家之母。於防則不足懲奸亂之源，於情則傷孝子之思，男不御罪於他族，而女獨嬰戮於二門，非所以哀矜女弱，均法制之大分也。臣以為在室之女，可從父母之刑，既醮之婦，使從夫家之戮。」朝廷從之，乃定律令。晉諸公贊曰：曾以高雅稱，加性純孝，位至太宰，封朗陵縣公。年八十餘薨，諡曰元公。子邵嗣。邵字敬祖，才識深博，有經國體儀。位亦至太宰，諡康公。子蕤嗣。邵庶兄遵，字思祖，有幹能。少經清職，終於太僕。遵子綏，字伯蔚，亦以幹事稱。永嘉中為尚書，為司馬越所殺。傅子稱曾及荀顗曰：「以文王之道事其親者，其潁昌何侯乎！其荀侯乎！古稱曾、閔，今曰荀、何。內盡其心以事其親，外崇禮讓以接天下。孝子，百世之宗；仁人，天下之令也。有能行仁孝之道者，君子之儀表矣。」
:::
:::
:::

## Xíng Yóng {.unnumbered #xingyong}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Xíng Yóng appellation Zǐ'áng was a Héjiān Mò man. Nominated Filial-Incorruptible, the Excellency over the Masses recruited him, all he did not accept. He changed his family name and appellation, traveled to Yòuběipíng, with Tián Chóu roaming. Accumulated to five years, then Tàizǔ settled Jì Province, [Xíng] Yóng spoke to [Tián] Chóu stating: "From the rising of the Huángjīn it has been over twenty years, Within the Seas a boiling cauldron, the Hundred Surnames wandering and scattered. Now hearing that Cáo-gōng's law orders are strict, the people weary of chaos, chaos peaking then is pacification. I request to personally go ahead." Therefore he packed and returned to his hometown. Tián Chóu said: "Xíng Yóng has foresight for the people." Thus he met Tàizǔ, requested to be a local guide in the subduing of Liǔchéng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
邢顒、字子昂，河間鄚人也。舉孝廉，司徒辟，皆不就。易姓字，適右北平，從田疇游。積五年，而太祖定冀州。顒謂疇曰：「黃巾起來二十餘年，海內鼎沸，百姓流離。今聞曹公法令嚴。民厭亂矣，亂極則平。請以身先。」遂裝還鄉里。田疇曰：「邢顒，民之先覺也。」乃見太祖，求為鄉導以克柳城。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ recruited [Xíng] Yóng as Jì Province Following Official, at the time people praised him stating: "Virtue and conduct grand and magnificent is Xíng Zǐ'áng." Appointed Guǎngzōng Chief,^[Guǎngzōng county was in Jùlù prefecture. Counties with fewer than ten thousand households were led by a Chief (zhǎng) instead of a Magistrate (lìng).] due to mourning for his former commander abandoned office. Relevant managers cited him for correction, Tàizǔ said: "[Xíng] Hóng's sincerity toward his old lord has universal integrity." Did not investigate. Again recruited as an Excellency of Work's Assistant, appointed Xíngtáng Magistrate,^[Xíngtáng county was in Chángshān prefecture.] encouraged the people to agriculture and sericulture, public moral transformation greatly spread. Entered as Assistant Chancellor's Gatemen Supervisor, promoted to Zuǒpíngyì, fell ill, left office. At the time, Tàizǔ's various sons highly selected office associates, Order said: "The household clerks of the Marquesses should obtain the profound and deep in law regulations like the sort as Xíng Yǒng." Therefore he became the Marquess of Píngyuán [Cáo] Zhí's household deputy. [Xíng] Yǒng guarded boundaries by ritual, without any bending or yielding, because of this they were not harmonious. Retainer Liú Zhēn's letter remonstrating [Cáo] Zhí stated: "Household Deputy Xíng Yóng is the elegant of the northern lands, from youth maintained lofty integrity, profound and tranquil, calmly moored, few words but much reasoning, truly a refined serviceman. [I, Liú] Zhēn truly am not enough to share a line with this man, together arrayed Left and Right, but [I, Liú] Zhēn encoutner courtesies encounter exceptional and special, but [Xíng] Yóng instead is distanced and neglected, I privately fear that those observing will say that Your Lord Marquess is accustomed to being near to the degenerate, courtesy to the worthy insufficient, selecting spring flowers for the Retainer, forgetting the autumn fruits of the Household Deputy. Attracting slander to one's superior, the crime is not small, because of this I toss and turn." Later became Advisor to Assistant Chancellor's Army Affairs, transferred to East Department Assistant. Previously, the Heir-Apparent was not yet determined, and the Marquess of Línzī [Cáo] Zhí had favor, Dīng Yí and others together praised and supported his beauty. Tàizǔ asked [Xíng] Yóng, [Xíng] Yóng replied stating: "Having the lesser succeed the clan is what former generations warned against. May Your Highness deeply and heavily investigate it." Tàizǔ recognized his intention, later therefore appointed him Heir-Apparent's Junior Tutor, promoted to Grand Tutor. Emperor Wén ascended the throne, became Attendant Central and Secretariat Writers Deputy Director, bestowed noble title as Marquess Within the Passes, sent out as Director of Retainers Colonel, transferred to Minister of Ceremonies. Huángchū Fourth Year died. His son [Xíng] Yǒu succeeded. <a href="#annotation-22" id="source-22">[22]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖辟顒為冀州從事，時人稱之曰：「德行堂堂邢子昂。」除廣宗長，以故將喪棄官。有司舉正，太祖曰：「顒篤於舊君，有一致之節。」勿問也。更辟司空掾，除行唐令，勸民農桑，風化大行。入為丞相門下督，遷左馮翊，病，去官。是時，太祖諸子高選官屬，令曰：「侯家吏，宜得淵深法度如邢顒輩。」遂以為平原侯植家丞。顒防閑以禮，無所屈撓，由是不合。庶子劉楨書諫植曰：「家丞邢顒，北土之彥，少秉高節，玄靜澹泊，言少理多，真雅士也。楨誠不足同貫斯人，並列左右。而楨禮遇殊特，顒反疏簡，私懼觀者將謂君侯習近不肖，禮賢不足，採庶子之春華，忘家丞之秋實。為上招謗，其罪不小，以此反側。」後參丞相軍事，轉東曹掾。初，太子未定，而臨菑侯植有寵，丁儀等並贊翼其美。太祖問顒，顒對曰：「以庶代宗，先世之戒也。願殿下深重察之！」太祖識其意，後遂以為太子少傅，遷太傅。文帝踐阼，為侍中尚書僕射，賜爵關內侯，出為司隸校尉，徙太常。黃初四年薨。子友嗣。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-22" id="annotation-22">[22]</a> Jìn Zhūgōng Zàn states: [Xíng] Yóng's great-grandson [Xíng] Qiáo appellation Zēngbó had broad character and competence in office, praised in his era. Successively served in pure duties. During Yuánkāng [291 - 299] with Liú Huàn together were Secretariat Writers Personnel Bureau Cadets, gradually promoted to reach Director of Retainers Colonel.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　晉諸公贊曰：顒曾孫喬，字曾伯。有體量局幹，美於當世。歷清職。元康中，與劉渙俱為尚書吏部郎，稍遷至司隸校尉。
:::
:::
:::

## Bào Xūn {.unnumbered #baoxun #baoxin}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Bào Xūn appellation Shūyè was a Tàishān Píngyáng man, Hàn's Director of Retainers Colonel Bào Xuān's ninth generation descendant. [Bào] Xuān's posterity successors had those from Shàngdǎng relocated to Tàishān and therefore house there. [Bào] Xūn's father [Bào] Xìn in Emperor Líng's time was a Cavalry Commandant, General-in-Chief Hé Jìn sent him east to recruit troops. Later he became Jǐběi Chancellor, cooperated plans with Tàizǔ, personally encountered harm. The story is in [Dǒng Zhuó's biography](06.qmd#dongzhuo) and [Emperor Wǔ's Annals](01.qmd#caocao). <a href="#annotation-23" id="source-23">[23]</a> Jiàn'ān Seventeenth Year [212], Tàizǔ recalled and recorded [Bào] Xìn's achievements, memorialized to enfeoff [Bào] Xūn's elder brother [Bào] Shào as Marquess of Xīndū precinct. <a href="#annotation-24" id="source-24">[24]</a> Recruited [Bào] Xūn as Assistant Chancellor's Assistant. <a href="#annotation-25" id="source-25">[25]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
鮑勛字叔業，泰山平陽人也，漢司隸校尉鮑宣九世孫。宣後嗣有從上黨徙泰山者，遂家焉。勛父信，靈帝時為騎都尉，大將軍何進遣東募兵。後為濟北相，協規太祖，身以遇害。語在董卓傳、武帝紀。〔一〕建安十七年，太祖追錄信功，表封勛兄邵新都亭侯。〔二〕辟勛丞相掾。〔三〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-23" id="annotation-23">[23]</a> Wèi shū states: [Bào] Xìn's father [Bào] Dān's office reached Minister Treasurer and Attendant Central, (the family) prominent for generations for classicist refinement. From youth he had great integrity, generous and tolerant and loving of people, resolute and firm and having planning ability. General-in-Chief Hé Jìn recruited and appointed him a Cavalry Commandant, sent to return home to recruit troops, obtained over a thousand people, returned and arrived at Chénggāo but [Hé] Jìn had already come to harm. [Bào] Xìn reached the capital region, Dǒng Zhuó also had just arrived. [Bào] Xìn knew [Dǒng] Zhuó certainly would make chaos, urged Yuán Shào to surprise attack [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Yuán] Shào feared [Dǒng] Zhuó and did not dare mobilize. The story is in [Yuán] [Shào's biography](06.qmd#yuanshao). [Bào] Xìn then withdrew his army to return to his hometown, collected follower multitudes of twenty thousand, cavalry of seven hundred, heavy supplies of over five thousand wagons. That year, Tàizǔ first raised troops at Jǐwú, [Bào] Xìn with his younger brohter [Bào] Tāo with their troops welcomed Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ with Yuán Shào memorialized [Bào] Xìn as Acting Defeating Caitiffs General, [Bào] Tāo as Supplementary General. At the time [Yuán] Shào's multitudes were the most flourishing, of powerful figures many turned to him. [Bào] Xìn alone spoke to Tàizǔ stating: "The one with strategies the would could not produce, capable of leading outstanding heroes to bring chaos to order, is you sir. If it is not the person, even if strong they will certainly fall. You are probably what Heaven has brought." Therefore he extremely bound himself in friendship. Tàizǔ also was exceptionally close with him. At the defeat at Biàn river, [Bào] Xìn was wounded, [Bào] Tāo in the battle lines died. [Yuán] Shào seized away Hán Fù's position and therefore occupied Jì Province. [Bào] Xìn's advice to Tàizǔ said: "A traitor minister takes advantage of quarrels, sweeps away and overturns the Royal House, outstanding heroes exerting integrity, Heaven's Under turning to answer, this is righteousness. Now [Yuán] Shào is the Alliance Leader, uses power to seize advantage, about to himself create chaos, this is to have another [Dǒng] Zhuó. If we restrain him, then our strength cannot control him, only to encounter trouble, and then what could be achieved? For now we can plan for the Great Hé's south, to wait for changes." Tàizǔ agreed with this. Tàizǔ became Dōng Prefecture Administrator, memorialized [Bào] Xìn as Jǐběi Chancellor. It happened that Huángjīn great multitudes entered the provincial borders, Liú Dài wished to battle with them, [Bào] Xìn stopped him, [Liú] Dài did not listen, and therefore was destroyed. The story is in the [Wǔ Annals](01.qmd#caocao). Tàizǔ believed the rebels to have become arrogant from their victory, wished to set up ambush troops to provoke and strike them at Shòuzhāng. First he and [Bào] Xìn went out to tour the battlefield, the rear infantry army had not yet arrived, when suddenly they encountered the rebels, and therefore engaged in battle. [Bào] Xìn fought to the death to save Tàizǔ, Tàizǔ was barely able to break through the encirclement and exit, [Bào] Xìn therefore was lost, at the time aged forty-one. Although he encountered chaos and raised troops, his family originally were refined classicists, he managed himself with utmost frugality, and generously cared for officers and servicemen, his residence had no surplus wealth, servicemen because of this submitted to him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：信父丹，官至少府侍中，世以儒雅顯。少有大節，寬厚愛人，沈毅有謀。大將軍何進辟拜騎都尉，遣歸募兵，得千餘人，還到成皋而進已遇害。信至京師，董卓亦始到。信知卓必為亂，勸袁紹襲卓，紹畏卓不敢發。語在紹傳。信乃引軍還鄉里，收徒眾二萬，騎七百，輜重五千餘乘。是歲，太祖始起兵於己吾，信與弟韜以兵應太祖。太祖與袁紹表信行破虜將軍，韜裨將軍。時紹眾最盛，豪傑多向之。信獨謂太祖曰：「夫略不世出，能總英雄以撥亂反正者，君也。苟非其人，雖彊必斃。君殆天之所啟！」遂深自結納，太祖亦親異焉。汴水之敗，信被瘡，韜在陳戰亡。紹劫奪韓馥位，遂據冀州。信言於太祖曰：「奸臣乘釁，蕩覆王室，英雄奮節，天下嚮應者，義也。今紹為盟主，因權專利，將自生亂，是復有一卓也。若抑之，則力不能制，祗以遘難，又何能濟？且可規大河之南，以待其變。」太祖善之。太祖為東郡太守，表信為濟北相。會黃巾大眾入州界，劉岱欲與戰，信止之，岱不從，遂敗。語在武紀。太祖以賊恃勝而驕，欲設奇兵挑擊之於壽張。先與信出行戰地，後步軍未至，而卒與賊遇，遂接戰。信殊死戰，以救太祖，太祖僅得潰圍出，信遂沒，時年四十一。雖遭亂起兵，家本修儒，治身至儉，而厚養將士，居無餘財，士以此歸之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-24" id="annotation-24">[24]</a> Wèi shū states: [Bào] Shào had his father's mannerisms, Tàizǔ commended him, applied appointment of Cavalry Commandant, Envoy Holding Stave. [Bào] Shào died, his son [Bào] Róng succeeded.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：邵有父風，太祖嘉之，加拜騎都尉，使持節。邵薨，子融嗣。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-25" id="annotation-25">[25]</a> Wèi shū states: [Bào] Xūn was pure and had high integrity, famed in the era.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏書曰：勛清白有高節，知名於世。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Twenty-Second Year [217], established the Heir-Apparent, appointed [Bào] Xūn as Central Retainer. Transferred to Yellow Gate Attendant Cadet, sent out as Wèi Prefecture West Division Commandant. The Heir-Apparent's madame Guō's younger brother became a Qǔzhōu county clerk, cut and stole government cloth, by law the answer was public execution. Tàizǔ at the time was at Qiáo, the Heir-Apparent remaining at Yè, and repeatedly hand-wrote letters to plead for the crime. [Bào] Xūn did not dare usurp authority to release him, and completely reported up the situation. [Bào] Xūn formerly at the East Palace had maintained uprightness without bending, the Heir-Apparent indeed could not be pleased, and reaching again to this matter, his anger and disappointment became increasingly extreme. It happened that the prefecture border troops on leave had one miss their appointment, secretly ordered the Central Commandant to memorialize to dismiss [Bào] Xūn from office. Long after this, appointed Attendant Censor. Yánkāng Inaugural Year [220], Tàizǔ passed away, the Heir-Apparent succeeded the King's position, [Bào] Xūn became Side Horse Commandant and simultaneous Attendant Central.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
二十二年，立太子，以勛為中庶子。徙黃門侍郎，出為魏郡西部都尉。太子郭夫人弟為曲周縣吏，斷盜官布，法應棄市。太祖時在譙，太子留鄴，數手書為之請罪。勛不敢擅縱，具列上。勛前在東宮，守正不撓，太子固不能悅，及重此事，恚望滋甚。會郡界休兵有失期者，密敕中尉奏免勛官。久之，拜侍御史。延康元年，太祖崩，太子即王位，勛以駙馬都尉兼侍中。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Emperor Wén received the abdication, [Bào] Xūn always explained: "Presently what is urgent is only in the army and agriculture, leniency and kindness to the Hundred Surnames. The terrace pavillions and gardens and parks should be for later." When Emperor Wén was about to go out hunting, [Bào] Xūn stopped the carriage and sent up memorial stating: "Your Servant has heard that of the Five Emperors and Three Kings none did not make clear fundamentals and establish instruction, using filial piety to govern Heaven's Under. Your Majesty is benevolent and sagely, compassionate and empathic, having similarity to the ancient martyrs. Your Servant hopes you will continue the tracks of former dynasties, to be capable of an example for ten thousand generations, how can you in the middle of the dark rooms^[The dark rooms (liàng'àn) referred to the locations where monarchs observed mourning for their parents.] engage in the affairs of galloping and hunting? Your Servant braves death to be heard, may Your Majesty investigate it." The Emperor hand destroyed the memorial and insisted on going hunting. In the middle of the road stopping to rest, he asked the attendant ministers stating: "Hunting as a delight, how does it compare to the eight tones?"^[The eight tones (bāyīn) refer to an ancient classification system of eight types of musical instruments.] Attendant Central Liú Yè replied stating: "Hunting surpasses in delight."^[Alternatively this may be translated as "Hunting surpasses over music." The words for delight (lè) and music (yuè) are written using the same character.] [Bào] Xūn's opposition statement said: "Music above connects to the divine intelligence, below harmonizes with human principles, expands governance and conveys moral transformation, myriad countries all ordered. In shifting customs and changing habits, nothing is better than music. As for hunting, it exposes the Flower Canopy^[Flower Canopy (huágài) is a term referring to the chariot of Emperors.] in the wild plains, injures the utmost principles of nurturing life, combs with wind and washes in rain, with no consideration for seasonal rests. In the past Lǔ Yǐn observed fish at Táng, the Chūnqiū ridiculed him. Though Your Majesty takes it as your business, it is what Your Foolish Servant is not willing to do." He took advantage to memorialize: "Liú Yè is a flattering sycophant and not loyal, fawning and following Your Majesty's statement of excessive amusement. In the past Liángqiū Jù sought to flatter at Chuán Terrace, this is the meaning of [Liú] Yè. I request relevant managers to discuss punishments to purify the Imperial Temple." The Emperor was furious and changed color, ended (the hunt) and returned, at once sent out [Bào] Xūn as Right Central Cadet General.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
文帝受禪，勛每陳「今之所急，唯在軍農，寬惠百姓。臺榭苑囿，宜以為後。」文帝將出游獵，勛停車上疏曰：「臣聞五帝三王，靡不明本立教，以孝治天下。陛下仁聖惻隱，有同古烈。臣冀當繼蹤前代，令萬世可則也。如何在諒闇之中，修馳騁之事乎！臣冒死以聞，唯陛下察焉。」帝手毀其表而競行獵，中道頓息，問侍臣曰：「獵之為樂，何如八音也？」侍中劉曄對曰：「獵勝於樂。」勛抗辭曰：「夫樂，上通神明，下和人理，隆治致化，萬邦咸乂。移風易俗，莫善於樂。況獵，暴華蓋於原野，傷生育之至理，櫛風沐雨，不以時隙哉？昔魯隱觀漁於棠，春秋譏之。雖陛下以為務，愚臣所不願也。」因奏：「劉曄佞諛不忠，阿順陛下過戲之言。昔梁丘據取媚於遄臺，曄之謂也。請有司議罪以清皇廟。」帝怒作色，罷還，即出勛為右中郎將。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Huángchū Fourth Year [223], Secretariat Writers Director Chén Qún and Deputy-Director Sīmǎ [Yì] Xuān-wáng together nominated [Bào] Xūn as Palace Rectifier. Palace Rectifier was Censorate Central Deputy. The Emperor could not but employ him, the Hundred Bureaus were disciplined and fearful, none were not solemn and respectful. Sixth Year [225] Autumn, the Emperor wished to campaign against Wú, the various ministers greatly discussed, [Bào] Xūn to the face remonstrated stating: "That the Royal Brigades repeatedly campaign but have not yet had success, is probably because Wú and Shǔ are as lips and teeth supporting one another, rely on hindering mountains and rivers, having a situation of being difficult to uproot. In previous years the dragon boat floated and swept apart to the south bank, your Sagely Person tread into danger, the ministers subordinates were broken in fear.^[Broken in fear (pòdàn) can be more literally understood as "broken gallbladder," based on an ancient folk belief associating the gallbladder with courage.] At this time the Ancestral Temple was almost overturned, to be a warning for a hundred generations. Now to again labor the troops and distantly raid, daily expenses in thousands of gold, the central states are emptied by wastage, allowing the crafty caitiffs to mock your prestige, Your Servant humbly believes it cannot be." The Emperor increased in anger at him, demoted [Bào] Xūn to be Managing Writers Law Enforcer.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
黃初四年，尚書令陳群、僕射司馬宣王並舉勛為宮正，宮正即御史中丞也。帝不得已而用之，百寮嚴憚，罔不肅然。六年秋，帝欲征吳，群臣大議，勛面諫曰：「王師屢征而未有所克者，蓋以吳、蜀脣齒相依，憑阻山水，有難拔之勢故也。往年龍舟飄蕩，隔在南岸，聖躬蹈危，臣下破膽。此時宗廟幾至傾覆，為百世之戒。今又勞兵襲遠，日費千金，中國虛耗，令黠虜玩威，臣竊以為不可。」帝益忿之，左遷勛為治書執法。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
The Emperor from Shòuchūn returned, garrisoned Chénliú prefecture's border. The Administrator Sūn Yōng was met and went out and passed by [Bào] Xūn. At the time the camp ramparts were not yet complete, only setting marker enclosures, [Sūn] Yōng walked through not following the correct path, Army Camp Director Scribe Liú Yào wished to cite him, [Bào] Xūn because the moats and ramparts were not complete released and stopped it and did not cite it. The main army returned to Luòyáng, [Liú] Yào had a crime, [Bào] Xūn memorialized to expel and dismiss him, but [Liú] Yào secretly memorialized the matter of [Bào] Xūn privately releasing [Sūn] Yōng. Edict said: "[Bào] Xūn calls a deer a horse,^[This is an accusation of treachery, referencing a famous story of the Qín Second Emperor and the Qín Chancellor Zhào Gāo: Zhào Gāo was plotting against the Emperor but wished to identify his potential allies and enemies, and therefore presented a deer to the Qín Court, claiming it was a horse. All those that insisted that it was a horse, Zhào Gāo arranged to have arrested and executed. Not long after Zhào Gāo launched his coup against the Emperor.] arrest and send to the Minister of Justice." The Minister of Justice discussed the law: "Correct Punishment Five Years."^[Year Punishments (suì xíng) was a type of penal servitude punishment. The convicted was shaved and forced to serve in penal labor for a certain number of years.] The Three Offices^[The Three Offices (sān guān) here refer to the three departments involved in law enforcement: the Minister of Justice, the Censorate Central Deputy, and the Director of Retainers Colonel.] disputed: "According to legal code fine gold two jīn." The Emperor was greatly furious and said: "[Bào] Xūn has no right to live, yet you all dare release him! Arrest the Three Offices on down to send to the Inspectors of Treason, to have ten rats share a hole."^[Ten (shí) may be meant as "all" rather than a literal number.] Grand Commandant Zhōng Yáo, Excellency over the Masses Huà Xīn, Defending Army General-in-Chief Chén Qún, Attendant Central Xīn Pí, Secretariat Writer Wèi Zhēn, Observing Minister of Justice Gāo Róu and others together memorialized: "[Bào] Xūn's father [Bào] Xìn had achievements to Tàizǔ," requesting and pleading for [Bào] Xūn's punishment. The Emperor did not agree, therefore executed [Bào] Xūn. [Bào] Xūn's inner conduct was already cultivated, incorruptible and capable of giving out, on the day of his death, his household had no surplus wealth. After twenty days Emperor Wén also passed away, none did not sigh in regret for [Bào] Xūn. 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
帝從壽春還，屯陳留郡界。太守孫邕見，出過勛。時營壘未成，但立標埒，邕邪行不從正道，軍營令史劉曜欲推之，勛以塹壘未成，解止不舉。大軍還洛陽，曜有罪，勛奏絀遣，而曜密表勛私解邕事。詔曰：「勛指鹿作馬，收付廷尉。」廷尉法議：「正刑五歲。」三官駮：「依律罰金二斤。」帝大怒曰：「勛無活分，而汝等敢縱之！收三官已下付刺姦，當令十鼠同穴。」太尉鍾繇、司徒華歆、鎮軍大將軍陳群、侍中辛毗、尚書衛臻、守廷尉高柔等並表「勛父信有功於太祖」，求請勛罪。帝不許，遂誅勛。勛內行既脩，廉而能施，死之日，家無餘財。後二旬，文帝亦崩，莫不為勛歎恨。
:::
:::

## Sīmǎ Zhī {.unnumbered #simazhi}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Sīmǎ Zhī appellation Zǐhuā was a Hénèi Wēn man. In youth he was a scholar, fled the chaos to Jīng Province, at Lǔyáng mountain encountered bandits, those travelling with him all abandoned their old and weak to flee, [Sīmǎ] Zhī alone sat and defended his aged mother. The bandits arrived, with blade overlooked [Sīmǎ] Zhī, [Sīmǎ] Zhī knocked head and said: "My mother is old, and only has you sirs." The bandits said: "This is a filial son, killing him is not righteous." Therefore he avoided harm, and with a deer cart^[Deer cart (lù chē) was a type of small single-wheel cart, similar to the Wooden Ox (mù niú) made famous by Zhūgě Liàng. The "deer" and "ox" descriptions referred to the handles of the cart, which resembled horns.] pushed to convey his mother. Resided in the south for over ten years, personally plowed and maintained integrity.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
司馬芝字子華，河內溫人也。少為書生，避亂荊州，於魯陽山遇賊，同行者皆棄老弱走，芝獨坐守老母。賊至，以刃臨芝，芝叩頭曰：「母老，唯在諸君！」賊曰：「此孝子也，殺之不義。」遂得免害，以鹿車推載母。居南方十餘年，躬耕守節。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ pacified Jīng Province, appointed [Sīmǎ] Zhī as Jiān Chief.^[Jiān county was in Jǐnán prefecture. Counties with fewer than ten thousand households were headed by a Chief (zhǎng) instead of a Magistrate (lìng).] At the time Heaven's Under was only beginning to settle, many did not observe the law. The Prefecture Registrar Liú Jié was of an old clan of powerful vigilantes, retainers of over a thousand families, going out as thieves and bandits, going in to disorder clerk governance. Shortly after this, [Sīmǎ] Zhī conscripted [Liú] Jié's retainer Wáng Tóng and others as troops, the Assistant Scribe Jù reported: "[Liú] Jié's family beginning to end has never once provided for conscription. If reaching the time they hide them, certainly they will become a later burden." [Sīmǎ] Zhī did not listen, his letter to [Liú] Jié stated: "You sir are of a great clan, and morever are leg and arm to the prefecture, but your retainers always do not participate in conscription, already the masses are resentful and disappointed, sometimes spreading rumors above are heard. Now in conscripting [Wáng] Tóng and the rest as soldiers, it would be fortunate if they are timely sent." Troops had aleady gathered at the prefecture, but [Liú] Jié hid [Wáng] Tóng and the rest, took advantage to order the Postal Supervisors to use the army mobilization to extort the county, the county assistant scribes were destitute, and begged to take [Wáng] Tóng's place in going. [Sīmǎ] Zhī then galloped with dispatch to Jǐnán, completely explaining [Liú] Jié's crime. The Administrator Hǎo Guāng previously respected and trusted [Sīmǎ] Zhī, at once had [Liú] Jié take [Wáng] Tóng's place in going, Qīng Province called [Sīmǎ] Zhī "Using a prefecture Registrar as soldier." Promoted to Guǎngpíng Magistrate.^[Guǎngpíng county was in Jùlù prefecture.] Campaigning against Caitiffs General Liú Xūn was noble and favored, arrogant and powerful, and also was [Sīmǎ] Zhī's former prefecture commander, his guest retainers and junior relatives at the border repeatedly violated law. [Liú] Xūn wrote [Sīmǎ] Zhī a letter, not writing family name and personal name, but made many recommendations and requests, [Sīmǎ] Zhī did not reply to the letter, and completely followed the law. Later [Liú] Xūn for treachery was executed, those that had dealings with him all obtained punishment, but [Sīmǎ] Zhī met with praise. <a href="#annotation-26" id="source-26">[26]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖平荊州，以芝為菅長。時天下草創，多不奉法。郡主簿劉節，舊族豪俠，賓客千餘家，出為盜賊，入亂吏治。頃之，芝差節客王同等為兵，掾史據白：「節家前後未嘗給繇，若至時藏匿，必為留負。」芝不聽，與節書曰：「君為大宗，加股肱郡，而賓客每不與役，既眾庶怨望，或流聲上聞。今（條）〔調〕同等為兵，幸時發遣。」兵已集郡，而節藏同等，因令督郵以軍興詭責縣，縣掾史窮困，乞代同行。芝乃馳檄濟南，具陳節罪。太守郝光素敬信芝，即以節代同行，青州號芝「以郡主簿為兵」。遷廣平令。征虜將軍劉勳，貴寵驕豪，又芝故郡將，賓客子弟在界數犯法。勳與芝書，不著姓名，而多所屬託，芝不報其書，一皆如法。後勳以不軌誅，交關者皆獲罪，而芝以見稱。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-26" id="annotation-26">[26]</a> Wèi lüè states: [Liú] Xūn appellation Zǐtái was a Lángyé man. At the end of Zhōngpíng, he became Pèi state's Jiànpíng's Chief, with Tàizǔ having old friendship. Later he became Lújiāng Administrator, was defeated by Sūn Cè, submitted himself to Tàizǔ, enfeoffed a Ranked Marquess, and therefore followed among the irregular consultants. [Liú] Xūn's elder brother was Yù Province Inspector, fell ill and died. His elder brother's son [Liú] Wēi also succeeded in attending to government. [Liú] Xūn self-relied on having an old relationship with Tàizǔ, daily arrogant and haughty, repeatedly violated law, and also slandered. He was reported by Lǐ Shēnchéng, arrested and punished, and further removed [Liú] Wēi from office.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏略曰：勳字子臺，瑯邪人。中平末，為沛國建平長，與太祖有舊。後為廬江太守，為孫策所破，自歸太祖，封列侯，遂從在散伍議中。勳兄為豫州刺史，病亡。兄子威，又代從政。勳自恃與太祖有宿，日驕慢，數犯法，又誹謗。為李申成所白，收治，并免威官。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Promoted to Minister Judge Rectifier.^[Minister Judge Rectifier (dàlǐzhèng) was a law officer under the Minister Judge (dàlǐ).] There was stolen government raw silk placed on top of a latrine, the clerks suspected the female workers, arrested and sent them to prison. [Sīmǎ] Zhī said: "In the failures of punishing crimes, failures are in harsh brutality. Now stolen goods are first found and then afterwards there is interrogation of the testimonies, if they cannot bear the beatings, perhaps it reaches to false confession. The situation of false confession cannot be used for deciding prison cases. Moreover being simple and easy to follow is the moral transformation of great men. Not ommitting the guilty is merely the governance of a mediocre era. Now to pardon the doubtful, to expand the principle of being easy to follow, is it not also permissable?" Tàizǔ followed this suggestion. Successively was Gānlíng, Pèi, Yángpíng Administrator, wherever he was he had accomplishments. During Huángchū, entered as Hénán Intendant, restrained the strong and supported the weak, private requests were not enacted. It happened that an inner official wished to have a matter entrusted to [Sīmǎ] Zhī, did not dare speak out, and therefore used [Sīmǎ] Zhī's wife's father's elder brother Dǒng [Zhāo]. [Dǒng] Zhāo yet feared [Sīmǎ] Zhī, and did not pass it on. [Sīmǎ] Zhī made instructions to his varoius subordinates stating: "Overall a lord is able to establish instructions, but not able to cause his clerks to certainly not violate them. Clerks are able to violate instructions, but cannot cause the lord to certainly not hear of it. To establish instructions but have them violated is the inferiority of the lord. To violate instructions and be heard, is disaster for the clerks. Lord inferior above, clerks disastrous below, this is how government affairs are not managed. Can we not each make exhortations?" Thereupon of the subordinate clerks none did not exhort themselves. A gate patrol once suspected a gate keeper of stealing a hairpin, the keeper's testimony did not match, the department sent him to prison. [Sīmǎ] Zhī's instructions said: "Generally for objects that have resemblances and are difficult to distinguish, if it is not Lílóu,^[Lílóu, also known as Lízhū, was a figure from high antiquity said to have extraordinarily strong eyesight.] few are able to not be confused. Even if this truly happened, how can a patrol bear to heavily begrudge a single hairpin and think lightly of injuring a colleague? Thus dismiss and do not investigate."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
遷大理正。有盜官練置都廁上者，吏疑女工，收以付獄。芝曰：「夫刑罪之失，失在苛暴。今贓物先得而後訊其辭，若不勝掠，或至誣服。誣服之情，不可以折獄。且簡而易從，大人之化也。不失有罪，庸世之治耳。今宥所疑，以隆易從之義，不亦可乎！」太祖從其議。歷甘陵、沛、陽平太守，所在有績。黃初中，入為河南尹，抑彊扶弱，私請不行。會內官欲以事託芝，不敢發言，因芝妻伯父董昭。昭猶憚芝，不為通。芝為教與群下曰：「蓋君能設教，不能使吏必不犯也。吏能犯教，而不能使君必不聞也。夫設教而犯，君之劣也；犯教而聞，吏之禍也。君劣於上，吏禍於下，此政事所以不理也。可不各勉之哉！」於是下吏莫不自勵。門下循行嘗疑門幹盜簪，幹辭不符，曹執為獄。芝教曰：「凡物有相似而難分者，自非離婁，鮮能不惑。就其實然，循行何忍重惜一簪，輕傷同類乎！其寢勿問。」
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Emperor Míng succeeded the throne, bestowed noble rank as Marquess Within the Passes. Shortly after this, Specially Advanced Cáo Hóng's wet nurse Dāng with the Princess of Línfén's attendant together worshipped the Wújiàn divinity <a href="#annotation-27" id="source-27">[27]</a> and were bound in prison. Dowager Empress Biàn sent a Yellow Gate to visit the Office to transmit orders, [Sīmǎ] Zhī did not connect with them, and at once ordered Luòyáng prison to investigate to completion, and then sent up memorial stating: "For those that deserve death penalties, all should first be memorialized and wait for reply. Previously regulation letter forbade and cut off illicit sacrifices to correct customs, now Dāng and the rest have violations of witchcraft crimes, the testimony statements were just settled, Yellow Gate Wú Dá visited Your Servant, transmitting the Grand Imperial Dowager Empress's Order. Your Servant did not dare connect with them, fearing there would be rescue and protection, quickly heard by Your Sagely listening, if it could not but be so, it would lead to delay. Because the matter did not early complete, it is Your Servant's crime, therefore violated regular legal code, at once ordered the county to investigate to completion, usurped authority to enact punishment and execution, in prostration I wait for execution and punishment." The Emperor's hand-written reply stated: "Examining your memorial, enlightened minister your utmost heart wished to serve Edict letter, by expedience enacting affairs, was correct. This then was your intention to serve Edict, what apologies are to be had? Later if Yellow Gates again go, be cautious to not connect with them." [Sīmǎ] Zhī held office for eleven years, repeatedly discussed what legal code articles were not convenient. When among the Excellencies and Ministers we walked the straight way. It happened that the vassal Kings came to Court, with people in the capital city had communications, in connection he was dismissed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
明帝即位，賜爵關內侯。頃之，特進曹洪乳母當，與臨汾公主侍者共事無澗神〔一〕繫獄。卞太后遣黃門詣府傳令，芝不通，輒敕洛陽獄考竟，而上疏曰：「諸應死罪者，皆當先表須報。前制書禁絕淫祀以正風俗，今當等所犯妖刑，辭語始定，黃門吳達詣臣，傳太皇太后令。臣不敢通，懼有救護，速聞聖聽，若不得已，以垂宿留。由事不早竟，是臣之罪，是以冒犯常科，輒敕縣考竟，擅行刑戮，伏須誅罰。」帝手報曰：「省表，明卿至心，欲奉詔書，以權行事，是也。此乃卿奉詔之意，何謝之有？後黃門復往，慎勿通也。」芝居官十一年，數議科條所不便者。其在公卿閒，直道而行。會諸王來朝，與京都人交通，坐免。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-27" id="annotation-27">[27]</a> Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wújiàn is a mountain name, at Luòyáng's northeast.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　臣松之案：無澗，山名，在洛陽東北。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Later became Minister of Agriculture. Before this the various Managers of Agriculture and their respective clerks and civilians engaged in tip work^[Tip work (mò zuò) refers to commerce. Agriculture was considered the root (běn), and so commerce was the tip (mò) or end, opposite the root or foundation (běn).] and making a living,^[Making a living (zhì shēng) refers to running a private business.] to seek profit returns. [Sīmǎ] Zhī's memorial stated: "The governance of a King is to esteem the root and suppress the tip, attend to agriculture and value grain. Wáng Zhì: 'Without three years of reserves, a state is not a state.'^[Wáng Zhì is a chapter in the Lǐjì.] Guǎn-zǐ Qūyán^[Qūyán is a chapter in the Guǎn-zǐ, a compilation of the writings and teachings of Guǎn Zhòng.] treats accmulating grain as urgent. Right now the two caitiffs are not yet exterminated, the brigades and regiments not resting, what is vital to the state and country is only in grain and silk. Wǔ Huángdì specially opened the offices of Garrison Farms, focused on taking agriculture and sericulture as enterprise. During Jiàn'ān [196 - 220], Under Heaven the granaries were full, the Hundred Surnames flourishing and ample. From Huángchū [220 - 226] onward, it is heard that the various Managers of Agriculture make livings, each calculating for division subordinates, this truly is not appropriate for the great forms of the country. A King takes Within the Seas as household, therefore the Zhuàn states: 'If the Hundred Surnames are not sufficient, with who is the Lord sufficient?' Wealthy and sufficient farm fields is in not missing Heaven's seasons and being exhaustive in the Earth's strengths. Now what merchant travelers seek, although there are prominent profits of doubling, however for the unified calculation, already there are immeasurable losses, it is not as good as reclaiming farm lands to increase income by one mǔ.^[Mǔ is a unit of land area.] Farmers in working the fields from the Standard Moon plow and plant, weed and hoe, prume mulberries, plow and dry and sow wheat, reap and mow and build threshing floors, in the Tenth Moon then finished. Repairing granaries and fastening bridges, transporting taxes, clearing roads and managing bridges, plastering and painting houses and rooms, thus is the end of the year, no day is not used for agricultural affairs. Now the various Managers of Agriculture each say: 'Those that stay calculate for the clan farm fields for those that go, allocate the labor, the situation is it cannot not be so. If there is not anything neglected, then there naturally was surplus labor.' Your Servant humbly believes it is not appropriate to have commercial affairs mix and confuse, focus only on agriculture and sericulture for their work, for the state's calculations it would be convenient." Emperor Míng followed this.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
後為大司農。先是諸典農各部吏民，末作治生，以要利入。芝奏曰：「王者之治，崇本抑末，務農重穀。王制：『無三年之儲，國非其國也。』管子區言以積穀為急。方今二虜未滅，師旅不息，國家之要，惟在穀帛。武皇帝特開屯田之官，專以農桑為業。建安中，天下倉廩充實，百姓殷足。自黃初以來，聽諸典農治生，各為部下之計，誠非國家大體所宜也。夫王者以海內為家，故傳曰：『百姓不足，君誰與足！』富足之田，在於不失天時而盡地力。今商旅所求，雖有加倍之顯利，然於一統之計，已有不貲之損，不如墾田益一畝之收也。夫農民之事田，自正月耕種，耘鋤條桑，耕熯種麥，穫刈築場，十月乃畢。治廩繫橋，運輸租賦，除道理梁，墐塗室屋，以是終歲，無日不為農事也。今諸典農，各言『留者為行者宗田計，課其力，勢不得不爾。不有所廢，則當素有餘力。』臣愚以為不宜復以商事雜亂，專以農桑為務，於國計為便。」明帝從之。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Every time superior officials had any summons or inquiry, always he first met the assistant clerks, to determine the intentions and reasons, instructed how to answer and satisfy the situation, all was as he judged. [Sīmǎ] Zhī by nature was bright and direct, did not boast of incorrutibility. When conversing with guest retainers, if there was something against his opinions, then to the face he would point out shortcomings, in withdrawing there were no dissenting words. Died in office, his family had no surplus wealth, from Wèi reaching to the present of those that were Hénán Intendant none reached to [Sīmǎ] Zhī.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
每上官有所召問，常先見掾史，為斷其意故，教其所以答塞之狀，皆如所度。芝性亮直，不矜廉隅。與賓客談論，有不可意，便面折其短，退無異言。卒於官，家無餘財，自魏迄今為河南尹者莫及芝。
:::
:::

### son Sīmǎ Qí {.unnumbered #simaqi}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Sīmǎ] Zhī died, his son [Sīmǎ] Qí succeeded, from Hénán Deputy transferred to Minister of Justice Rectifier, promoted to Chénliú Chancellor. Liáng prefecture had bound prisoners, many were connected and implicated, for several years it was not resolved. Edict letter transferred the prison cases to [Sīmǎ] Qí's subordinate county, the county requested to in advance prepare prison equipment. [Sīmǎ] Qí said: "Now the prisoners are several tens, already their deceits difficult to verify, moreover already fatigued from torture, the situation easy to see. How could they further for a long time be kept in prison?" Reaching the prison cells, he interrogated them, of all none dared conceal and deceive, in one morning the resolution was complete, therefore promoted to Minister of Justice. At the time General-in-Chief [Cáo] Shuǎng held power, Secretariat Writers Hé Yàn, Dèng Yáng and others were his assistant wings. Nányáng's Guī Tài once in words offended their intentions, interrogated and bound in the Ministry of Justice. [Dèng] Yáng interrogated the prison case, about to deliver [Guī] Tài to heavy punishment. [Sīmǎ] Qí rebuked [Dèng] Yáng stating: "You are a critical chief minister, aide of the Royal House, already you are not able to assist moral transformation and achieve virtue, equal in beauty to the ancients, but instead you then are unrestrained in private angers, unjustly discussing those without crime. Causing the Hundred Surnames to be uncertain in heart, is it not in this?" [Dèng] Yáng thereupon was ashamed and angry and so withdrew. [Sīmǎ] Qí in the end feared he had long obtained guilts, claimed illness to leave office. Resided at home for less than a year he died, aged thirty-five. His son [Sīmǎ] Zhào succeeded. <a href="#annotation-28" id="source-28">[28]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
芝亡，子岐嗣，從河南丞轉廷尉正，遷陳留相。梁郡有繫囚，多所連及，數歲不決。詔書徙獄于岐屬縣，縣請豫治牢具。岐曰：「今囚有數十，既巧詐難符，且已倦楚毒，其情易見。豈當復久處囹圄邪！」及囚室，詰之，皆莫敢匿詐，一朝決竟，遂超為廷尉。是時大將軍爽專權，尚書何晏、鄧颺等為之輔翼。南陽圭泰嘗以言迕指，考繫廷尉。颺訊獄，將致泰重刑。岐數颺曰：「夫樞機大臣，王室之佐，既不能輔化成德，齊美古人，而乃肆其私忿，枉論無辜。使百姓危心，非此焉在？」颺於是慚怒而退。岐終恐久獲罪，以疾去官。居家未期而卒，年三十五。子肇嗣。〔一〕
:::
:::

## Appraisal {.unnumbered}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Appraisal states: Xú Yì, Hé Kuí, Xíng Yóng valued and esteemed severe strictness, were the famed men of the era. Máo Jiè was pure and public-minded, unadorned in tread, [Sīmǎ] Zhī was loyal and bright without turning, approaching to not "spitting out the hard and swallowing the soft."^[This is a reference to the song Zhēng Mín in the Dà Yǎ section of the Shījīng, which as "soft then swallow it, hard then spit it out." The interpretation of "spitting out the hard and swallowing the soft" is to "avoid the strong and bully the weak."] Cuī Yǎn in lofty character was most exceptional, Bào Xūn maintained the correct without deficiency, but both did not save their persons, a pity! The Dà Yǎ values "Already Enlightened Moreover Wise,"^[This is a quote from the song Zhēng Mín in the Dà Yǎ section of the Shījīng.] the Yú Shū esteems "Direct yet capable of warmth,"^[This is a quote from the chapter Gāotáo Mó in the Yú Shū section of the Shàng Shū.] if not possessing both talents, who is capable of preparing it all?
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
評曰：徐奕、何夔、邢顒貴尚峻厲，為世名人。毛玠清公素履，司馬芝忠亮不傾，庶乎不吐剛茹柔。崔琰高格最優，鮑勛秉正無虧，而皆不免其身，惜哉！大雅貴「既明且哲」，虞書尚「直而能溫」，自非兼才，疇克備諸！ 
:::
:::
